402  NameQualificationTraversalAda::pathToGlobal(const SgScopeStatement& n) const
403  {
404  si::Ada::ScopePath res = si::Ada::pathToGlobal(n);
405 
406  // Add the fictitious (?) root of all scopes ;)
407  // A procedure referring to itself needs to add the standard prefix "Standard."
408  // iff its name is overloaded within the function.
409  // If Standard is not required, the namequal will cut it out as part
410  // of the common path elimination (NameQualificationTraversalAda::computeNameQual 1b).
411  // \code
412  // proc X (y:integer) is
413  // x : integer := y;
414  // begin
415  // Standard.X(x);
416  // end X;
417  // \endcode
418  res.push_back(si::Ada::pkgStandardScope());
419  return res;
420  }

423  bool symbolMatchesDeclaration(const SgSymbol& sym, const SgNode& dcl)
424  {
425  const SgDeclarationStatement* symdcl = si::Ada::associatedDeclaration(sym);
426 
427  if (!symdcl) return false;
428  if (symdcl == &dcl) return true;
429 
430  // for Ada language features check that spec and body refer to the same
431  // element.
432  if (const SgAdaPackageBodyDecl* bdydcl = isSgAdaPackageBodyDecl(&dcl))
433  return symdcl == si::Ada::getSpecificationDeclaration(bdydcl);
434 
435  if (const SgAdaPackageBodyDecl* bdydcl = isSgAdaPackageBodyDecl(symdcl))
436  return &dcl == si::Ada::getSpecificationDeclaration(bdydcl);
437 
438  if (const SgAdaTaskBodyDecl* bdydcl = isSgAdaTaskBodyDecl(&dcl))
439  return symdcl == si::Ada::getSpecificationDeclaration(bdydcl);
440 
441  if (const SgAdaTaskBodyDecl* bdydcl = isSgAdaTaskBodyDecl(symdcl))
442  return &dcl == si::Ada::getSpecificationDeclaration(bdydcl);
443 
444  if (const SgAdaProtectedBodyDecl* bdydcl = isSgAdaProtectedBodyDecl(&dcl))
445  return symdcl == si::Ada::getSpecificationDeclaration(bdydcl);
446 
447  if (const SgAdaProtectedBodyDecl* bdydcl = isSgAdaProtectedBodyDecl(symdcl))
448  return &dcl == si::Ada::getSpecificationDeclaration(bdydcl);
449 
450  // for functions check that they have the same first nondefining declaration.
451  if (const SgFunctionDeclaration* fndcl = isSgFunctionDeclaration(&dcl))
452  if (const SgFunctionDeclaration* fnsydcl = isSgFunctionDeclaration(symdcl))
453  return fndcl->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() == fnsydcl->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration();
454 
455  return false;
456  }

505  std::string nodeName(const SgNode& n)
506  {
507  std::string res = sg::dispatch(NodeName{}, &n);
508 
509  // PP (10/24/22): To avoid false positives when unnamed variables
510  // are declared along the scope path (i.e., in a catch statement),
511  // a 'special' name is returned for unnamed scopes.
512  // \todo fix the underlying cause of false positive reporting..

517  bool isShadowedAlongPath( const SgNode& n,
518  si::Ada::ScopePath::const_reverse_iterator beg, si::Ada::ScopePath::const_reverse_iterator lim
519  )
520  {
521  std::string dclname = nodeName(n);
522  const SgDeclarationStatement* dcl = isSgDeclarationStatement(&n);
523  const SgScopeStatement* dclscope = dcl ? dcl->get_scope() : nullptr;
524 
525  auto pred = [&dclname, &n, dclscope](const SgScopeStatement* scope)->bool
526  {
527  const SgSymbol* sym = scope->lookup_symbol(dclname, nullptr, nullptr);
528  bool shadowed = (sym != nullptr);
529 
530  while (sym && shadowed)
531  {
532  shadowed = !symbolMatchesDeclaration(*sym, n);
533  sym = scope->next_any_symbol();
534  }
535 
536  // for Ada bodies check their dual spec
537  if (shadowed)
538  {
539  if (const SgAdaPackageBody* bdy = isSgAdaPackageBody(scope))
540  shadowed = (dclscope != si::Ada::getSpecificationDefinition(bdy));
541  else if (const SgAdaProtectedBody* bdy = isSgAdaProtectedBody(scope))
542  shadowed = (dclscope != bdy->get_spec());
543  else if (const SgAdaTaskBody* bdy = isSgAdaTaskBody(scope))
544  shadowed = (dclscope != bdy->get_spec());
545  }
546 
547 
548  if (DBG_PRINT_SCOPES)
549  {
550  std::cerr << "+++ " << typeid(*scope).name() << " " << shadowed
551  << std::endl;
552 
553  // const_cast<SgScopeStatement*>(scope)->print_symboltable(dclname, std::cerr);
554  }
555 
556 
557  // if a symbol with the same name exists in the scope
558  // but the original declaration does not, then
559  // the declaration is shadowed.
560 
561  return shadowed;
562  };
563 
564  bool const res = std::any_of(beg, lim, pred);
565 
566  if (DBG_PRINT_SCOPES)
567  std::cerr << "+++++" << dclname << ": " << &n << " " << typeid(n).name()
568  << ": " << std::distance(beg, lim)
569  << ": " << res
570  << std::endl;
571 
572  return res;
573  }

575  std::string
576  NameQualificationTraversalAda::nameQualString( si::Ada::ScopePath::const_reverse_iterator beg,
577  si::Ada::ScopePath::const_reverse_iterator lim
578  ) const
579  {
580  const NameQualificationTraversalAda* self = this;
581 
582  auto scopeFn = [self](std::string qual, const SgScopeStatement* scope)->std::string
583  {
584  //~ std::cerr << "nqs: " << qual << " + " << typeid(*scope).name() << std::flush;
585 
586  const SgStatement* ref = nullptr;
587 
588  // if the scope is visible, produce a fully qualified scope
589  if (self->isVisibleScope(scope))
590  {
591  ref = scope;
592  }
593  else if (const SgDeclarationStatement* alt = self->renamedScope(scope))
594  {
595  // use a renamed alternative for scope, and reset the path
596  //~ std::cerr << " *use renamed* ";
597  ref = alt;
598  qual.clear();
599  }
600  else
601  {
602  // use full path as fallback
603  ref = scope;
604  }
605 
606  ScopeDetails scopedet = scopeName(ref);
607 
608  if (scopedet.qualBarrier())
609  {
610  // names cannot be qualified across unnamed
611  // blocks.
612  ROSE_ASSERT(scopedet.name().empty());
613  qual.clear();
614  }
615  else if (!scopedet.name().empty())
616  {
617  qual += scopedet.name();
618  //~ qual += "(";
619  //~ qual += typeid(*ref).name();
620  //~ qual += ")";
621  qual += '.';
622  }
623 
624  //~ std::cerr << " -> " << qual << std::endl;
625  return qual;
626  };
627 
628  return std::accumulate(beg, lim, std::string{}, scopeFn);
629  }

668  usableScope(const SgScopeStatement& scope)
669  {
670  const SgNode* namedNode = namedAstNode(&scope);
671  std::string scopeName = namedNode ? nodeName(SG_DEREF(namedNode)) : std::string{};
672 
673  if ((scopeName == "") || (scopeName == NodeName::AN_UNREAL_NAME))
674  return { false, nullptr };
675 
676  return { true, namedNode };
677  }
678 
679  template <class ScopePathIterator>
680  std::tuple<ScopePathIterator, const SgNode*>
681  namedAncestorScope(ScopePathIterator beg, ScopePathIterator pos, const SgNode* refNode)
682  {
683  if (beg == pos)
684  return { pos, refNode };
685 
686  ScopePathIterator prvpos = std::prev(pos);
687  std::tuple<bool, const SgNode*> usable = usableScope(**prvpos);
688 
689  if (std::get<0>(usable))
690  return { prvpos, std::get<1>(usable) };
691 
692  return namedAncestorScope(beg, prvpos, refNode);
693  }
694 
695  template <class ScopePathIterator>
696  ScopePathIterator
697  extendNameQualUntilUnambiguous( ScopePathIterator remBeg,
698  ScopePathIterator remMin,
699  ScopePathIterator remLim,
700  ScopePathIterator locMin,
701  ScopePathIterator locLim,
702  const SgNode& declOrRef
703  )
704  {
705  const SgNode* refNode = &declOrRef;
706 
707  // set the reference Node to the leading scope name (remMin != remLim)
708  // or start with the actual declOrRef node otherwise.
709  if (remMin != remLim)
710  if (const SgNode* namedNode = namedAstNode(*remMin))
711  refNode = namedNode;
712  // else ROSE_ABORT(); // \todo do we always have to have a node?
713 
714  // while the refnode is aliased along [locMin, locLim) and the scope is extensible |remBeg,remMin| > 0
715  // extend the scope by one.
716  while ((std::distance(remBeg, remMin) > 0) && isShadowedAlongPath(*refNode, locMin, locLim))
717  {
718  std::tie(remMin, refNode) = namedAncestorScope(remBeg, remMin, refNode);
719  }
720 
721  return remMin;
722  }
723 
724 
725  template <class ScopePathIterator>
726  ScopePathIterator
727  shortenPathForUseDirectives( ScopePathIterator /*remBeg*/,
728  ScopePathIterator remMin,
729  ScopePathIterator remLim,
730  const NameQualificationTraversalAda& /*trav*/
731  )
732  {
733  // right now only handle package Standard ..
734  // \todo check if any scope in (remMin, remLim)
735  // is in trav.isUsedScope
736 
737  // scopepath cannot be shortened?
738  if (remMin == remLim)
739  return remMin;
740 
741  // shorten path if package Standard
742  if (*remMin == si::Ada::pkgStandardScope())
743  return std::next(remMin);
744 
745  return remMin;
746  }

748  auto
749  areSpecAndBody(const SgScopeStatement* lhs, const SgScopeStatement* rhs) -> bool
750  {
751  if (const SgAdaProtectedSpec* spec = isSgAdaProtectedSpec(lhs))
752  return spec->get_body() == rhs;
753 
754  if (const SgAdaTaskSpec* spec = isSgAdaTaskSpec(lhs))
755  return spec->get_body() == rhs;
756 
757  if (const SgAdaPackageSpec* spec = isSgAdaPackageSpec(lhs))
758  return si::Ada::getBodyDefinition(spec) == rhs;
759 
760  return false;
761  }
762 
763 
771  template <class ScopePathIterator>
772  auto
773  adaPathMismatch( ScopePathIterator lhsPos, ScopePathIterator lhsLim,
774  ScopePathIterator rhsPos, ScopePathIterator rhsLim
775  )
776  -> std::pair<ScopePathIterator, ScopePathIterator>
777  {
778  while ((lhsPos != lhsLim) && (rhsPos != rhsLim) && (*lhsPos == *rhsPos))
779  {
780  if ((lhsPos != lhsLim) && areSpecAndBody(*lhsPos, *(lhsPos+1)))
781  ++lhsPos;
782 
783  if ((rhsPos != rhsLim) && areSpecAndBody(*rhsPos, *(rhsPos+1)))
784  ++rhsPos;
785 
786  ++lhsPos; ++rhsPos;
787  }
788 
789  return {lhsPos, rhsPos};
790  }
791 
792  std::string
793  NameQualificationTraversalAda::computeNameQual( const SgNode& quasiDecl,
794  const SgScopeStatement& local,
795  const SgScopeStatement& remote
796  ) const
797  {
798  using PathIterator = si::Ada::ScopePath::reverse_iterator;
799 
800  si::Ada::ScopePath remotePath = pathToGlobal(remote);
801  si::Ada::ScopePath localPath = pathToGlobal(local);
802  ASSERT_require(remotePath.size() != 0);
803 
804  if (DBG_PRINT_SCOPES)
805  std::cerr << "rp = " << DebugSeqPrinter{remotePath}
806  << " remote-scope = " << typeid(remote).name() << " " << &remote
807  << std::endl;
808 
809  // compute the required scope qualification
810  // assume a decl declared in scope a.b.c
811  // and referenced in scope a.d.e:
812 
813  // 1a determine the first mismatch (mismPos) of the (reversed) scope paths "a.b.c" and "a.d.e"
814  const PathIterator locBeg = localPath.rbegin();
815  const PathIterator locLim = localPath.rend();
816  const PathIterator remBeg = remotePath.rbegin();
817  const PathIterator remLim = remotePath.rend();
818 
819  // 1b mismPos is "a|b.c and a|d.e", thus the required scope qualification is b.c
820  auto mismPos = adaPathMismatch(locBeg, locLim, remBeg, remLim);
821 
822  // 1c shorten b.c if any scope has a use-directive
823  mismPos.second = shortenPathForUseDirectives(remBeg, mismPos.second, remLim, *this);
824 
825  // 2 extend the path if an overload for front(b.c) exists somewhere in d.e
826  const PathIterator remPos = extendNameQualUntilUnambiguous( remBeg, mismPos.second, remLim,
827  mismPos.first, locLim,
828  quasiDecl
829  );
830 
831  // 3 Since a body has its spec as the logical ancestor scope, adjacent spec/body combination
832  // are filtered from the path.
833  const PathIterator remLmt = std::unique(remPos, remLim, areSpecAndBody);
834 
835  // turn the scope sequence into a name qualification string
836  const std::string res = nameQualString(remPos, remLmt);
837 
838  if (DBG_PRINT_SCOPES)
839  {
840  std::cerr << "--- " << typeid(quasiDecl).name()
841  << " len> " << std::distance(mismPos.first, locLim)
842  << "/" << localPath.size() << DebugSeqPrinter{localPath}
843  << "/" << nameQualString(locBeg, locLim) // unsquashed
844  << " <> " << std::distance(mismPos.second, remLmt)
845  << "/" << std::distance(remPos, remLmt)
846  << " /" << nameQualString(remBeg, remLmt)
847  << " => " << res
848  << std::endl;
849  }
850 
851  return res;
852  }

927  void
928  NameQualificationTraversalAda::closeScope()
929  {
930  ROSE_ASSERT(state.scopeState.size());
931 
932  AdaScopeStackEntry& top = state.scopeState.back();
933 
934  // remove active renaming declarations and use clauses that were added
935  // in the scope that is about to end.
936  for (const SgScopeStatement* el : top.addedRenamings)
937  state.renamedScopes.erase(el);
938 
939  for (const SgScopeStatement* el : top.addedUsedScopes)
940  state.useScopes.erase(el);
941 
942  for (const SgScopeStatement* el : top.addedVisibleScopes)
943  state.visibleScopes.erase(el);
944 
945  state.scopeState.pop_back();
946  }

1670  void AdaPostNameQualifier::endOfScope(const SgScopeStatement& n)
1671  {
1672  const SgDeclarationStatement* parent = isSgDeclarationStatement(n.get_parent());
1673 
1674  if ( isSgAdaPackageSpecDecl(parent)
1675  || isSgAdaPackageBodyDecl(parent)
1676  || isSgFunctionDeclaration(parent)
1677  )
1678  {
1679  traversal.saveNameQualificationContext(*parent);
1680  }
1681 
1682  traversal.closeScope();
1683  }

1688  // is in the same or a different file.
1689  if (isSgGlobal(inheritedAttribute.get_currentScope()))
1690  traversal.resetNameQualificationContext();

1700  traversal.loadNameQualificationContext(*parent_dcl);
1701  else if (isSgGlobal(parent_scope))
1702  {
1703  traversal.addVisibleScope(si::Ada::pkgStandardScope());
1704  traversal.addUsedScope(si::Ada::pkgStandardScope());

1706 
1707  traversal.addVisibleScope(parent_scope);

1716  ASSERT_not_null(n);
1717  }
1718 */
1719  }

1740  void
1741  AdaPreNameQualifier::addRenamedScopeIfNeeded(const SgExpression* e, const SgAdaRenamingDecl& n)
1742  {
1743  if (const SgAdaRenamingRefExp* renref = isSgAdaRenamingRefExp(e))
1744  {
1745  addRenamedScopeIfNeeded(SG_DEREF(renref->get_decl()).get_renamed(), n);
1746  return ;
1747  }
1748 
1749  if (const SgAdaUnitRefExp* unitref = isSgAdaUnitRefExp(e))
1750  {
1751  const SgDeclarationStatement* dcl = unitref->get_decl();
1752 
1753  if (const SgAdaPackageSpecDecl* pkgspc = isSgAdaPackageSpecDecl(dcl))
1754  traversal.addRenamedScope(pkgspc->get_definition(), &n);
1755  else if (const SgAdaPackageBodyDecl* pkgbdy = isSgAdaPackageBodyDecl(dcl))
1756  traversal.addRenamedScope(SG_DEREF(pkgbdy->get_spec()).get_definition(), &n);
1757 
1758  // other unit refs?
1759  return;
1760  }
1761 
1762  if (/*const SgFunctionRefExp* funref =*/ isSgFunctionRefExp(e))
1763  {
1764 /*
1765  SgFunctionSymbol& funsym = SG_DEREF(funref->get_symbol());
1766 
1767  if (isSgAdaFunctionRenamingDecl(funsym.get_declaration())
1768  traversal.addRenamedScope(funsym.get_scope(), &n);
1769 */
1770  // \todo what needs to be done here?
1771  return;
1772  }
1773 
1774  // \todo for now the expected types are listed separately to understand
1775  // what kind of types can possibly occur here.
1776  // in the long run, just returning should be sufficient.
1777 
1778  if (/*const SgAdaTaskRefExp* tskref =*/ isSgAdaTaskRefExp(e))
1779  return;
1780 
1781  if (/*const SgAdaProtectedRefExp* tskref =*/ isSgAdaProtectedRefExp(e))
1782  return;
1783 
1784  if (/*const SgTypeExpression* tskref =*/ isSgTypeExpression(e))
1785  return;
1786 
1787  if (/*const SgVariableSymbol* varsym =*/ isSgVarRefExp(e))
1788  return;
1789 
1790  if (/*const SgPntrArrRefExp* arref =*/ isSgPntrArrRefExp(e))
1791  return;
1792 
1793  if (/*const SgDotExp* fldref =*/ isSgDotExp(e))
1794  return;
1795 
1796  if (/*const SgPointerDerefExp* ptrref =*/ isSgPointerDerefExp(e))
1797  return;
1798 
1799  if (/*const SgCastExp* castexp =*/ isSgCastExp(e))
1800  return;
1801 
1802  if (/*const SgEnumVal* castexp =*/ isSgEnumVal(e))
1803  return;
1804 
1805  if (/*const SgEnumVal* castexp =*/ isSgVoidVal(e))
1806  return;
1807 
1808  if (/*const SgEnumVal* castexp =*/ isSgAdaAttributeExp(e))
1809  return;
1810 
1811  if (/*const SgEnumVal* castexp =*/ isSgNullExpression(e))
1812  return;
1813 
1814  if (/*const SgEnumVal* castexp =*/ isSgCharVal(e))
1815  return;
1816 
1817  if (e == nullptr)
1818  {
1819  mlog[WARN] << "nullptr in AdaPreNameQualifier::addRenamedScopeIfNeeded"
1820  << std::endl;
1821  }
1822  else
1823  {
1824  mlog[WARN] << "unexpected type in AdaPreNameQualifier::addRenamedScopeIfNeeded " << typeid(*e).name()
1825  << std::endl;
1826  }
1827  }

1960  AdaPreNameQualifier::computeNameQualForShared(const SgNode& ref, const SgNode* n)
1961  {
1962  using NameQualMap = std::map<SgNode*, std::string>;
1963 
1964  NameQualMap& localQualMapForTypes = traversal.createQualMapForTypeSubtreeIfNeeded(ref);
1965  NameQualificationTraversalAda sub{traversal, localQualMapForTypes};
1966  InheritedAttribute attr{res};
1967 
1968  // fix the reference node for the type subtree traversal
1969  attr.set_typeReferenceNode(ref);
1970  // explore the sub-tree
1971  sub.traverse(const_cast<SgNode*>(n), attr);

1977  void
1978  AdaPreNameQualifier::computeNameQualForNonshared(const SgNode* n, bool inTypeSubtree)

1981  ROSE_ASSERT( (!inTypeSubtree)
1982  || (&traversal.get_qualifiedNameMapForNames() != &SgNode::get_globalQualifiedNameMapForNames())
1983  );
1984 
1985  NameQualificationTraversalAda sub{traversal, traversal.get_qualifiedNameMapForNames()};
1986  InheritedAttribute attr{res};
1987 
1988  // the reference node for the type subtree traversal should be set already..
1989  //~ attr.set_typeReferenceNode(n);
1990 
1991  // explore the sub-tree
1992  sub.traverse(const_cast<SgNode*>(n), attr);
1993  }

2007  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>&
2008  NameQualificationTraversalAda::createQualMapForTypeSubtreeIfNeeded(const SgNode& n)
2009  {
2010  // are we already in type traversal mode?
2011  if (&SgNode::get_globalQualifiedNameMapForNames() != &qualifiedNameMapForNames)
2012  return qualifiedNameMapForNames;
2013 
2014  // not yet in type traversal => create a new qualified name map for types
2015  SgNode* key = const_cast<SgNode*>(&n);
2016  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>& res = qualifiedNameMapForMapsOfTypes[key];
2017 
2018  // do we see this reference node for the first time?
2019  /*
2020  if (!res.empty())
2021  {
2022  const SgTypedefDeclaration* tydcl = isSgTypedefDeclaration(&n);
2023 
2024  mlog [ WARN ] << "map already exists for " << typeid(n).name()
2025  << ( tydcl ? std::string{tydcl->get_name()} : std::string{} )
2026  << std::endl;
2027  }
2028  */
2029 
2030  //~ ROSE_ASSERT(res.empty());
2031  return res;
2032  }

2436 int
2437 numberOfSymbolsWithName( const SgName & name, SgScopeStatement* scope )
2438  {
2439  // DQ (6/20/2011): This function counts the number of symbols associated with the same name.
2440  // This function should be put into the SgScopeStatement for more general use.
2441 
2442  // We might have to have separate functions specific to functions, variables, etc.
2443  // This function addresses a requirement associated with a bug demonstrated by test2011_84.C.
2444 
2445  ASSERT_not_null(scope);
2446  SgSymbol* symbol = scope->lookup_function_symbol(name);
2447 
2448  int count = 0;
2449 
2450 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
2451  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In numberOfSymbolsWithName(): symbol = %p scope = %p = %s \n",symbol,scope,scope->class_name().c_str());
2452 #endif
2453 
2454  while (symbol != NULL)
2455  {
2456 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
2457  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" In loop: symbol = %p = %s \n",symbol,symbol->class_name().c_str());
2458 #endif
2459  count++;
2460  symbol = scope->next_any_symbol();
2461  }
2462 
2463 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
2464  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In numberOfSymbolsWithName(): count = %d \n",count);
2465 #endif
2466 
2467  return count;
2468  }

2470 SgDeclarationStatement*
2471 NameQualificationTraversal::associatedDeclaration(SgScopeStatement* scope)
2472  {
2473  SgDeclarationStatement* return_declaration = NULL;
2474  switch (scope->variantT())
2475  {
2476  case V_SgClassDefinition:
2477  {
2478  SgClassDefinition* definition = isSgClassDefinition(scope);
2479  ASSERT_not_null(definition);
2480 
2481  SgClassDeclaration* declaration = definition->get_declaration();
2482  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
2483 
2484  return_declaration = declaration;
2485  break;
2486  }
2487 
2488  // DQ (11/20/2011): Added support for template declarations (template class declarations)
2489  case V_SgTemplateClassDefinition:
2490  {
2491  SgTemplateClassDefinition* definition = isSgTemplateClassDefinition(scope);
2492  ASSERT_not_null(definition);
2493 
2494  SgTemplateClassDeclaration* declaration = definition->get_declaration();
2495  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
2496 
2497  return_declaration = declaration;
2498  break;
2499  }
2500 
2501  case V_SgNamespaceDefinitionStatement:
2502  {
2503  SgNamespaceDefinitionStatement* definition = isSgNamespaceDefinitionStatement(scope);
2504  ASSERT_not_null(definition);
2505 
2506  // Let the first definition be used to get the associated first declaration so that we
2507  // are always refering to a consistant declaration for any chain of namespaces. If not
2508  // the first then perhaps the last?
2509  while (definition->get_previousNamespaceDefinition() != NULL)
2510  {
2511  // mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Iterating through the namespace chain... \n");
2512  definition = definition->get_previousNamespaceDefinition();
2513  }
2514 
2515  SgNamespaceDeclarationStatement* declaration = definition->get_namespaceDeclaration();
2516  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
2517 
2518  return_declaration = declaration;
2519  break;
2520  }
2521 
2522  case V_SgTemplateInstantiationDefn:
2523  {
2524  SgTemplateInstantiationDefn* definition = isSgTemplateInstantiationDefn(scope);
2525  ASSERT_not_null(definition);
2526 
2527  SgTemplateInstantiationDecl* declaration = isSgTemplateInstantiationDecl(definition->get_declaration());
2528  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
2529 
2530  return_declaration = declaration;
2531  break;
2532  }
2533 
2534  // DQ (7/11/2014): Added this case to support test2014_84.C.
2535  case V_SgFunctionDefinition:
2536  {
2537  SgFunctionDefinition* definition = isSgFunctionDefinition(scope);
2538  ASSERT_not_null(definition);
2539 
2540  SgFunctionDeclaration* declaration = isSgFunctionDeclaration(definition->get_declaration());
2541  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
2542 
2543  return_declaration = declaration;
2544  break;
2545  }
2546 
2547  // DQ (7/19/2017): Adding support for new SgDeclarationScope, though it might be that we want the parent defining or non-defining declaration.
2548  case V_SgDeclarationScope:
2549 
2550  // DQ (6/26/2019): Added rage-based for loop (see test2019_483.C).
2551  case V_SgRangeBasedForStatement:
2552 
2553  // Some scopes don't have an associated declaration (return NULL in these cases).
2554  // Also missing some of the Fortran specific scopes.
2555  case V_SgGlobal:
2556  case V_SgIfStmt:
2557  case V_SgWhileStmt:
2558  case V_SgDoWhileStmt:
2559  case V_SgForStatement:
2560  case V_SgForAllStatement:
2561  case V_SgBasicBlock:
2562  case V_SgSwitchStatement:
2563  case V_SgCatchOptionStmt:
2564  case V_SgUpcForAllStatement:
2565  case V_SgJovialForThenStatement:
2566  case V_SgAdaPackageSpec:
2567  {
2568  return_declaration = NULL;
2569  break;
2570  }
2571 
2572  // Catch anything that migh have been missed (and exit so it can be identified and fixed).
2573  default:
2574  {
2575  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Default reached in NameQualificationTraversal::associatedDeclaration() scope = %s \n",scope->class_name().c_str());
2576  ROSE_ABORT();
2577  }
2578  }
2579 
2580  return return_declaration;
2581  }
2582 
2583 SgDeclarationStatement*
2584 NameQualificationTraversal::associatedDeclaration(SgType* type)
2585  {
2586  SgDeclarationStatement* return_declaration = NULL;
2587 
2588  // DQ (1/26/2013): Added assertion.
2589  ASSERT_not_null(type);
2590 
2591  // DQ (4/15/2019): This is a new default that appears to work well for all of our ROSE regression tests.

3014 int
3015 NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepthOfParent(SgDeclarationStatement* declaration, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement )
3016  {
3017  // Now resolve how much name qualification is required.
3018  int qualificationDepth = 0;
3019 
3020 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
3021  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("***** Inside of NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepthOfParent() ***** \n");
3022  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" declaration = %p = %s = %s \n",declaration,declaration->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(declaration).c_str());
3023  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" currentScope = %p = %s = %s \n",currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(currentScope).c_str());
3024 #endif
3025 
3026  // qualificationDepth++;
3027  // SgDeclaration* classOrNamespaceDefinition = classDefinition->get_declaration()->get_scope();
3028  SgScopeStatement* parentScope = declaration->get_scope();
3029  // SgName parentName = associatedName(parentScope);
3030 
3031  // DQ (6/24/2018): Added assertion.
3032  ASSERT_not_null(parentScope);
3033 
3034 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
3035  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("***** Inside of NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepthOfParent() ***** \n");
3036  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" parentScope = %p = %s = %s \n",parentScope,parentScope->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(parentScope).c_str());
3037 #endif
3038 
3039  // qualificationDepth = nameQualificationDepth(parentName,parentScope,positionStatement) + 1;
3040  SgGlobal* globalScope = isSgGlobal(parentScope);
3041  if (globalScope != NULL)
3042  {
3043  // There is no declaration associated with global scope so we have to process the case of a null pointer...
3044 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 1)
3045  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("parentDeclaration == NULL: parentScope = %p = %s \n",parentScope,parentScope->class_name().c_str());
3046 #endif
3047 #if 0
3048  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("This case is not handled yet! \n");
3049  ROSE_ABORT();
3050 #endif
3051  }
3052  else
3053  {
3054  // Now ask the same question recursively using the parent declaration and the same currentScope (is it visible from the same point in the code).
3055  SgDeclarationStatement* parentDeclaration = associatedDeclaration(parentScope);
3056 
3057  // In some cases the declaration can be in a scope with is not associated with a declaration (e.g. SgBasicBlock or SgForStatement).
3058  if (parentDeclaration != NULL)
3059  {
3060 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
3061  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepthOfParent(): calling nameQualificationDepth(): parentDeclaration = %p = %s = %s \n",
3062  parentDeclaration,parentDeclaration->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(parentDeclaration).c_str());
3063  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- currentScope = %p = %s \n",currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str());
3064  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- parentScope = %p = %s \n",parentScope,parentScope->class_name().c_str());
3065  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- positionStatement = %p = %s \n",positionStatement,positionStatement->class_name().c_str());
3066 #endif
3067  // qualificationDepth = nameQualificationDepth(parentDeclaration,parentScope,positionStatement);
3068  qualificationDepth = nameQualificationDepth(parentDeclaration,currentScope,positionStatement);
3069  }
3070  }
3071 
3072 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
3073 // #if 0
3074  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Leaving nameQualificationDepthOfParent(): declaration = %p = %s \n",declaration,declaration->class_name().c_str());
3075 #endif
3076 
3077  return qualificationDepth;
3078  }

3080 bool
3081 NameQualificationTraversal::requiresTypeElaboration(SgSymbol* symbol)
3082  {
3083  // DQ (5/14/2011): type elaboration only works between non-types and types. Different types must be distinquished using name qualification.
3084  // If this is a type then since all types are given equal weight we need more name qualification to distinquish them.
3085  // However, if this is a non-type then type elaboration is sufficent to distinquish the type (e.g. from a variable name).
3086  bool typeElaborationRequired = false;
3087 
3088  ASSERT_not_null(symbol);
3089  switch (symbol->variantT())
3090  {
3091  case V_SgClassSymbol:

3262 
3263 int
3264 NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepth ( SgDeclarationStatement* declaration, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement, bool forceMoreNameQualification )
3265  {
3266  // Note that the input must be a declaration because it can include enums (SgDeclarationStatement IR nodes)
3267  // that don't have a corresponding definition (SgScopeStatement IR nodes).
3268 
3269  // This function computes the number of qualified names required to uniquely qualify and input reference.
3270  // It evaluates how much name qualification is required (typically 0 (no qualification), but sometimes
3271  // the depth of the nesting of scopes plus 1 (full qualification with global scoping operator)).
3272 
3273  // The positionStatement is the position of the associated reference to the declaration.
3274  // It is used when "using declarations" are not at the top of the scope. Initially
3275  // we will assume that the such "using declarations" are at the top of the scope.
3276 
3277  // How this works:
3278  // The function inputs are:
3279  // 1) the declaration whose reference we are evaluating for name qualification.
3280  // 2) the current scope of the reference to the declaration (the computed name qualification will be
3281  // prepended to the name of the declaration which is a reference to the declaration passed to this function).
3282  // 3) The positonStatement is required to allow name qualification decisions to be based on the reference
3283  // declarations position in scope relative to the input declaration. Some function declarations require
3284  // name qualification depending on if they appear before or after a prototype declaration for the function
3285  // that would define it's scope (seperate from its visability.
3286 
3287  // Note: we are evaluating the name qualification for references to declarations (e.g. the defining member
3288  // function outside of the class which contains the non-defining (prototype) member function declaration).
3289 
3290  // At this point, the symbol for the input function has been looked up in the parent scope of the declaration we are
3291  // evaluating for name qualification. The lookup is for any symbol matching the name, not the name plus the kind of
3292  // declaration (which will come in a next step). If it is not found, then it is not visible, and thus at least one level
3293  // of name qualification will be required. If it is found then we need an additional step to decide if the existence of
3294  // some declaration with that name will force name elaboration (type elaboration) or name qualification.
3295 
3296  // A test is done on the kind of symbol to determine if its associated declaration will force qualification or type
3297  // elaboration. If the symbol kind (of the kind of declaration associated with the symbol) matches the input declaration
3298  // then name qualification will be required, if it is a different kind of declaration the type elaboration might be all
3299  // that is required. For example, a variable name may be the same as a class name, but where this happens, only type
3300  // elaboration is required to distinquish the two. However, if a declaration name is classing with another declaration
3301  // name of the same kind, then only name qualification will distinguish the two.
3302 
3303  // If name qualification is required, then we repeat the lookup in the symbol table, using a more refined search to only
3304  // get symbols of the type that would force name qualification.
3305 
3306  // Note that this function is recursive, the current scope will remain fixed, but the declaration associated with the
3307  // target decaration will be walked up in the AST toward the global scope, each time computing the associated declaration
3308  // for each new scope where we evaluated. The count of the number of scopes (scope depth) required for name qualification
3309  // (until the scope containing the input declaration is found) is all that this function returns.
3310 
3311  // Note: this function is overloaded to take other kinds of IR nodes that require name qualification, but are not
3312  // SgDeclarationStatements (e.g. SgInitializedName).
3313 
3314  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
3315  ASSERT_not_null(currentScope);
3316  ROSE_ASSERT(forceMoreNameQualification == false);
3317  ASSERT_not_null(positionStatement);
3318 
3319  int qualificationDepth = 0;
3320  bool typeElaborationIsRequired = false;
3321 
3322 #define DEBUG_FUNCTION_RESOLUTION 0
3323 
3324 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
3325  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("\n\n########################################################################## \n");
3326  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("########################################################################## \n");
3327  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("########################################################################## \n");
3328  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("########################################################################## \n");
3329  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("##### Inside of NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepth() ##### \n");
3330  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("########################################################################## \n");
3331  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("########################################################################## \n");
3332  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("########################################################################## \n");
3333 
3334  // The use of SageInterface::generateUniqueName() can cause the unparser to be called and triggers the name
3335  // qualification recursively but only for template declaration (SgTemplateInstantiationDecl, I think).
3336  // mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("declaration = %p = %s = %s = %s \n",declaration,declaration->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(declaration).c_str(),SageInterface::generateUniqueName(declaration,true).c_str());
3337  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- declaration = %p = %s = %s \n",declaration,declaration->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(declaration).c_str());
3338  declaration->get_startOfConstruct()->display("declaration");
3339  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- currentScope = %p = %s = %s \n",currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(currentScope).c_str());
3340  currentScope->get_startOfConstruct()->display("currentScope");
3341  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- positionStatement = %p = %s \n",positionStatement,positionStatement->class_name().c_str());
3342  positionStatement->get_startOfConstruct()->display("positionStatement");
3343 #endif

3345 #if DEBUG__nameQualificationDepth

3351 #endif
3352

3354  SgClassDeclaration* classDeclaration = isSgClassDeclaration(declaration);

5311  currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str(),positionStatement,positionStatement->class_name().c_str());
5312 
5313  ASSERT_not_null(positionStatement);

5318  while (i != templateArgumentList.end())
5319  {

5333  {
5334  case SgTemplateArgument::type_argument:
5335  {
5336  ASSERT_not_null(templateArgument->get_type());

5338

5340 
5341  break;

5343 
5344  case SgTemplateArgument::nontype_argument:

5356  else

5361

5364 
5365  break;
5366  }
5367 
5368  case SgTemplateArgument::template_template_argument:

5380  case SgTemplateArgument::start_of_pack_expansion_argument:
5381  {

5394 
5395  default:

5400  }
5401 
5402  // DQ (5/29/2019): Older version of code.
5403  SgType* type = templateArgument->get_type();

5438  SgClassType* classType = isSgClassType(namedType);

5485  if (nrdecl->get_templateDeclaration() != NULL) {

5492

5495  nrdecl_parent = nrdecl_parent->get_parent();

5503 
5504  nrdecl = isSgNonrealDecl(nrdecl_parent);
5505  } while (nrdecl != NULL);

5509 
5510 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_FOR_TEMPLATE_ARGUMENTS

5515 
5516  // TV (10/09/2018): FIXME ROSE-1511
5517  SgNamespaceDefinitionStatement * nsp_defn = isSgNamespaceDefinitionStatement(currentScope);
5518  if (nsp_defn != NULL) {

5527  }
5528 
5529 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_FOR_TEMPLATE_ARGUMENTS

5538  }
5539  }
5540  }

5544  processNameQualificationForPossibleArrayType(type,currentScope);

5549  }
5550  else if (expression != NULL)

5566  generateNestedTraversalWithExplicitScope(expression,currentScope);

5595 
5596  i++;

5613 int
5614 NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepth ( SgType* type, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement )
5615  {
5616  int amountOfNameQualificationRequired = 0;
5617 
5618  ASSERT_not_null(type);
5619 
5620 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_FOR_NAME_QUALIFICATION_DEPTH || 0
5621  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In nameQualificationDepth(SgType*): type = %p = %s \n",type,type->class_name().c_str());
5622 #endif
5623 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5624  static int counter = 0;
5625  printf("In nameQualificationDepth(SgType*): counter = %d type = %p = %s \n",counter,type,type->class_name().c_str());
5626  counter++;
5627 #endif
5628 
5629  // DQ (7/23/2011): If this is an array type, then we need special processing for any name qualification of its index expressions.
5630  processNameQualificationForPossibleArrayType(type,currentScope);
5631 
5632  SgDeclarationStatement* declaration = getDeclarationAssociatedWithType(type);
5633  if (declaration != NULL)
5634  {
5635  // Check the visability and unambiguity of this declaration.
5636 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5637  printf("In nameQualificationDepth(SgType*): declaration != NULL: declaration = %p = %s \n",declaration,declaration->class_name().c_str());
5638 #endif
5639  amountOfNameQualificationRequired = nameQualificationDepth(declaration,currentScope,positionStatement);
5640 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_FOR_NAME_QUALIFICATION_DEPTH
5641  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("amountOfNameQualificationRequired = %d \n",amountOfNameQualificationRequired);
5642 #endif
5643 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5644  printf("amountOfNameQualificationRequired = %d \n",amountOfNameQualificationRequired);
5645 #endif
5646  }
5647  else
5648  {
5649 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_FOR_NAME_QUALIFICATION_DEPTH
5650  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("ERROR: In nameQualificationDepth(SgType*): declaration NOT found for type = %p = %s\n",type,type->class_name().c_str());
5651 #endif
5652 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5653  printf("ERROR: In nameQualificationDepth(SgType*): declaration NOT found for type = %p = %s\n",type,type->class_name().c_str());
5654 #endif
5655  }
5656 
5657 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_FOR_NAME_QUALIFICATION_DEPTH
5658  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Leaving nameQualificationDepth(SgType*): type = %p = %s amountOfNameQualificationRequired = %d \n",type,type->class_name().c_str(),amountOfNameQualificationRequired);
5659 #endif
5660 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5661  counter--;

5663  counter,type,type->class_name().c_str(),amountOfNameQualificationRequired);

5672 NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepthForType ( SgInitializedName* initializedName, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement )
5673  {
5674  ASSERT_not_null(initializedName);
5675  ASSERT_not_null(positionStatement);
5676 
5677 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
5678  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In nameQualificationDepthForType(): initializedName = %s type = %p = %s currentScope = %p = %s \n",initializedName->get_name().str(),initializedName->get_type(),initializedName->get_type()->class_name().c_str(),currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str());
5679 #endif
5680 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5681  printf("In nameQualificationDepthForType(): initializedName = %s type = %p = %s currentScope = %p = %s \n",
5682  initializedName->get_name().str(),initializedName->get_type(),initializedName->get_type()->class_name().c_str(),
5683  currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str());
5684 #endif
5685 
5686  SgType* initializedNameType = initializedName->get_type();
5687 
5688  SgPointerMemberType* pointerMemberType = isSgPointerMemberType(initializedNameType);
5689  if (pointerMemberType != nullptr)
5690  {
5691  SgType* baseType = pointerMemberType->get_base_type();
5692  ASSERT_not_null(baseType);
5693 
5694  // Handle member functions as a special case.
5695  SgMemberFunctionType* memberFunctionType = isSgMemberFunctionType(baseType);
5696  if (memberFunctionType != NULL)
5697  {
5698  SgType* returnType = memberFunctionType->get_return_type();
5699 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
5700  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("nameQualificationDepthForType(): case SgPointerMemberType: Reset associated initializedNameType: returnType = %p = %s \n",returnType,returnType->class_name().c_str());
5701 #endif
5702  initializedNameType = returnType;
5703  }
5704  else
5705  {
5706 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
5707  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("nameQualificationDepthForType(): case SgPointerMemberType: Reset associated initializedNameType: baseType = %p = %s \n",baseType,baseType->class_name().c_str());
5708 #endif
5709  initializedNameType = baseType;
5710  }
5711  }
5712 
5713 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
5714  printf ("Calling nameQualificationDepth(): initializedNameType = %p = %s \n",initializedNameType,initializedNameType->class_name().c_str());
5715 #endif
5716 
5717  // return nameQualificationDepth(initializedName->get_type(),initializedName->get_scope(),positionStatement);
5718  // return nameQualificationDepth(initializedName->get_type(),currentScope,positionStatement);
5719  return nameQualificationDepth(initializedNameType,currentScope,positionStatement);
5720  }

5722 int
5723 NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepth ( SgInitializedName* initializedName, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement )
5724  {
5725  int amountOfNameQualificationRequired = 0;
5726 
5727  ASSERT_not_null(initializedName);
5728  ASSERT_not_null(currentScope);
5729 
5730  SgName name = initializedName->get_name();
5731 
5732  // DQ (6/5/2011): Test if this has a valid name (if not then it need not be qualified).
5733  // Examples of tests codes: test2005_114.C and test2011_73.C.
5734  if (name.is_null() == true)
5735  {
5736  // An empty name implies that no name qualification would make sense.
5737  return 0;
5738  }
5739 
5740  ASSERT_not_null(initializedName->get_scope());
5741  SgDeclarationStatement* declaration = associatedDeclaration(initializedName->get_scope());
5742  SgVariableSymbol* variableSymbol = NULL;
5743 
5744  // DQ (8/16/2013): Modified to support new API.
5745  SgSymbol* symbol = SageInterface::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(name,currentScope,NULL,NULL);
5746

5748  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::nameQualificationDepth(SgInitializedName* = %p): symbol = %p \n",initializedName,symbol);

5751  if (symbol != NULL)

5753 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)

5757  // Loop over possible chain of alias symbols to find the original sysmbol.

5760  // DQ (7/12/2014): The newer design of the symbol table handling means that we will never see a SgAliasSymbol at this level.

5762 
5763  while (aliasSymbol != NULL)
5764  {
5765  // DQ (7/12/2014): The newer design of the symbol table handling means that we will never see a SgAliasSymbol at this level.
5766  ROSE_ABORT();
5767 #if 1
5768  // DQ (7/12/2014): debugging use of SgAliasSymbol.

5770 #endif
5771  symbol = aliasSymbol->get_alias();
5772  aliasSymbol = isSgAliasSymbol(symbol);
5773  }
5774  ROSE_ASSERT(isSgAliasSymbol(symbol) == NULL);
5775  variableSymbol = isSgVariableSymbol(symbol);
5776 
5777  if (variableSymbol == NULL)

5779  variableSymbol = SageInterface::lookupVariableSymbolInParentScopes(name,currentScope);
5780 
5781  // ASSERT_not_null(variableSymbol);

5790  }
5791 #endif
5792 
5793  if (declaration != NULL)

5796  }
5797  }

5799  {
5800 
5801 #define DEBUG_SKIP_VARIABLE_SYMBOL 0

5841  {

5861  skipThisSymbol = false;
5862  }
5863  }
5864  else
5865  {
5866  ROSE_ASSERT(possible_extern_variable_scope != NULL && original_variable_scope != NULL);
5867  if (possible_extern_variable_scope == original_variable_scope)
5868  {
5869  skipThisSymbol = false;
5870  }
5871  }
5872  }
5873  else

5876  skipThisSymbol = false;
5877  }
5878  }
5879  }
5880  }
5881 
5882 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_SKIP_VARIABLE_SYMBOL
5883  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("skipThisSymbol = %s \n",skipThisSymbol ? "true" : "false");

5885 
5886 #if 0
5887  // DQ (6/1/2019): Better to seatch if the scopes are the same then is the previous variable declaration was marked as extern.
5888  {
5889  if (variableDeclaration != NULL && variableDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().isExtern() && variableDeclaration->get_linkage().empty() == true)

5894  if ( (variableDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().isFriend() == false) && (isSgTemplateVariableDeclaration(variableDeclaration) == NULL) )

5899  skipThisSymbol = true;

5901  else
5902  {

5913  }
5914  }

5917  // DQ (6/4/2011): Get the associated symbol so that we can avoid matching on name only; and not the actual SgVariableSymbol symbols.

5923  // if (variableSymbol == targetInitializedNameSymbol)

5927  // Found the correct symbol.
5928 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)

5931  }
5932  else
5933  {

5935 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)

5939  // DQ (12/15/2014): Liao's move tool will cause this message to be output, but it is not a problem (I think).

5941  {

5950  // ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
5951  if (declaration != NULL)

5955  else
5956  {

5969  // SgDeclarationStatement* declaration = associatedDeclaration(initializedName->get_scope());

6018 void
6019 NameQualificationTraversal::addToNameMap ( SgNode* nodeReference, string typeNameString )
6020  {
6021 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6022  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In addToNameMap(): nodeReference = %p = %s typeNameString = %s \n",nodeReference,nodeReference->class_name().c_str(),typeNameString.c_str());
6023 #endif
6024 
6025  // DQ (6/21/2011): This is refactored code used in traverseType() and traverseTemplatedFunction().
6026  // bool isTemplateName = (typeNameString.find('<') != string::npos) && (typeNameString.find("::") != string::npos);
6027  bool isTemplateName = (typeNameString.find('<') != string::npos); // && (typeNameString.find("::") != string::npos);
6028 
6029  bool isPointerMemberType = (isSgPointerMemberType(nodeReference) != NULL);
6030 
6031  // DQ (4/21/2019): Unclear if we should store the intermediately generated strings for each part of a type.
6032  // I think that test2019_385.C makes it clear that we need to allow the SgPointerMemberType intermediate
6033  // strings to be reset.
6034  // isPointerMemberType = false;
6035 
6036  bool isInitializedName = (isSgInitializedName(nodeReference) != NULL);
6037 
6038  // DQ (4/28/2019): Adding support for the base type if a SgTypedefDeclaration.
6039  bool isTypedefDeclaration = (isSgTypedefDeclaration(nodeReference) != NULL);
6040 
6041  // DQ (4/28/2019): We only want to save the type as a string if it has a SgPointerMemberType (or a template instantiation).
6042  // I think the same thing is also true for the type associated with a SgInitializedName as well.
6043  SgTypedefDeclaration* typedefDeclaration = isSgTypedefDeclaration(nodeReference);
6044  if (typedefDeclaration != NULL)
6045  {
6046  SgType* baseType = typedefDeclaration->get_base_type();
6047 
6048  // We realy need to strip off any modifiers before we check if it is a SgPointerMembertype.
6049  unsigned char bit_array = SgType::STRIP_MODIFIER_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_REFERENCE_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_RVALUE_REFERENCE_TYPE |
6050  SgType::STRIP_POINTER_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_ARRAY_TYPE;
6051  baseType = baseType->stripType(bit_array);
6052  ASSERT_not_null(baseType);
6053 
6054  // Check if this is something that could be name qualified.
6055  SgPointerMemberType* pointerMemberType = isSgPointerMemberType(baseType);
6056  SgNamedType* namedType = isSgNamedType(baseType);
6057  // if (pointerMemberType == NULL)
6058  if (pointerMemberType == NULL && namedType == NULL)
6059  {
6060  isTypedefDeclaration = false;
6061  }
6062 
6063 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6064  // Find out what type this is, we need to detect template instantiations as well, so that they CAN be used to generate strings.
6065  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In addToNameMap(): case SgTypedefDeclaration: baseType = %p = %s \n",baseType,baseType->class_name().c_str());
6066 #endif
6067  }
6068 
6069  // DQ (4/28/2019): Handle the SgInitialzedName the same as the typedef.
6070  SgInitializedName* initializedName = isSgInitializedName(nodeReference);
6071  if (initializedName != NULL)
6072  {
6073  SgType* type = initializedName->get_type();
6074 
6075  // We realy need to strip off any modifiers before we check if it is a SgPointerMembertype.
6076  unsigned char bit_array = SgType::STRIP_MODIFIER_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_REFERENCE_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_RVALUE_REFERENCE_TYPE |
6077  SgType::STRIP_POINTER_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_ARRAY_TYPE;
6078  type = type->stripType(bit_array);
6079  ASSERT_not_null(type);
6080 
6081  // Check if this is something that could be name qualified.
6082  SgPointerMemberType* pointerMemberType = isSgPointerMemberType(type);
6083  SgNamedType* namedType = isSgNamedType(type);
6084  // if (pointerMemberType == NULL)
6085  if (pointerMemberType == NULL && namedType == NULL)
6086  {
6087  isInitializedName = false;
6088  }
6089 
6090 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6091  // Find out what type this is, we need to detect template instantiations as well, so that they CAN be used to generate strings.
6092  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In addToNameMap(): case SgInitializedName: type = %p = %s \n",type,type->class_name().c_str());
6093  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In addToNameMap(): case SgInitializedName: isInitializedName = %s \n",isInitializedName ? "true" : "false");
6094 #endif
6095  }
6096 
6097  // DQ (4/21/2019): The list of nodes which we will have to allow to store types as generated strings will
6098  // have to include expressions (SgNewExp, SgSizeOf, SgCastExp, SgTypeIdOp)
6099  // and functions (SgFunctionDeclaration)
6100  // and maybe that is about it.
6101 
6102 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6103  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In addToNameMap(): isTemplateName = %s isPointerMemberType = %s nodeReference = %p = %s typeNameString = %s \n",
6104  isTemplateName ? "true" : "false",isPointerMemberType ? "true" : "false",nodeReference,nodeReference->class_name().c_str(),typeNameString.c_str());
6105 #endif
6106 
6107  // DQ (4/21/2019): Adding case to support SgInitializedName.
6108  // DQ (4/18/2019): We need to support SgPointerMemberType as well.
6109  if (isTemplateName == true || isPointerMemberType == true || isInitializedName == true || isTypedefDeclaration == true)
6110  {
6111  if (typeNameMap.find(nodeReference) == typeNameMap.end())
6112  {
6113 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6114  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("============== Inserting qualifier for name = %s into typeNameMap list at IR node = %p = %s \n",
6115  typeNameString.c_str(),nodeReference,nodeReference->class_name().c_str());
6116 #endif
6117  typeNameMap.insert(std::pair<SgNode*,std::string>(nodeReference,typeNameString));
6118  }
6119  else
6120  {
6121  // If it already exists, then overwrite the existing information.
6122  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>::iterator i = typeNameMap.find(nodeReference);
6123  ROSE_ASSERT (i != typeNameMap.end());
6124 
6125  string previousTypeName = i->second.c_str();
6126 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6127  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: replacing previousTypeName = %s with new typeNameString = %s for nodeReference = %p = %s \n",
6128  previousTypeName.c_str(),typeNameString.c_str(),nodeReference,nodeReference->class_name().c_str());
6129 #endif
6130  if (i->second != typeNameString)
6131  {
6132  i->second = typeNameString;
6133 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6134  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In addToNameMap(): Allow this for replacement now! \n");
6135 #endif
6136  }
6137  }
6138  }
6139  else
6140  {
6141 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6142  // DQ (8/19/2013): comment added for debugging.
6143  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::addToNameMap(): isTemplateName == false, typeNameString = %s NOT added to typeNameMap for key = %p = %s \n",typeNameString.c_str(),nodeReference,nodeReference->class_name().c_str());
6144 #endif
6145  }
6146 
6147  }

6150 void
6151 NameQualificationTraversal::traverseType ( SgType* type, SgNode* nodeReferenceToType, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement )
6152  {
6153  // The type can contain subtypes (e.g. template arguments) and when the subtypes need to be name qualified the name of the encompassing type
6154  // has a name that depends upon its location in the source code (and could vary depending on the positon in a single basic block, I think).
6155 
6156 #define DEBUG_TRAVERSE_TYPE 0
6157 
6158 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_TYPE
6159  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("<<<<< Starting traversal of type: type = %p = %s \n",type,type->class_name().c_str());
6160  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In traverseType(): nodeReferenceToType = %p = %s \n",nodeReferenceToType,nodeReferenceToType->class_name().c_str());
6161 #endif
6162 
6163  // DQ (4/27/2019): If this is an un-named type then it can't be name qualified, so we can exit directly.
6164  // We don't want to generate strings to represent the types from unNamed declarations that could not be name qualified anyway.
6165  bool isUnNamed = false;
6166  // SgNamedType* namedType = isSgNamedType(type);
6167  unsigned char bit_array = SgType::STRIP_MODIFIER_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_REFERENCE_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_RVALUE_REFERENCE_TYPE |
6168  SgType::STRIP_POINTER_TYPE | SgType::STRIP_ARRAY_TYPE;
6169  SgType* strippedType = type->stripType(bit_array);
6170 
6171 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_TYPE
6172  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In traverseType(): strippedType = %p = %s \n",strippedType,strippedType->class_name().c_str());
6173 #endif
6174 
6175  SgNamedType* namedType = isSgNamedType(strippedType);
6176  if (namedType != NULL)
6177  {
6178  SgEnumType* enumType = isSgEnumType(namedType);
6179  SgClassType* classType = isSgClassType(namedType);
6180 
6181  if (enumType != NULL)
6182  {
6183  SgEnumDeclaration* enumDeclaration = isSgEnumDeclaration(enumType->get_declaration());
6184  ASSERT_not_null(enumDeclaration);

6691 NameQualificationTraversal::traverseTemplatedClass(SgBaseClass* baseClass, SgNode* nodeReference, SgScopeStatement* currentScope, SgStatement* positionStatement )
6692  {
6693  // DQ (4/12/2019): Notes on Cxx11_tests/test342.C:
6694  // It may be that we need a function like "traverseTemplatedFunction" for classes to support the reference to a template class instantiation in a SgBaseClass.
6695  // The issue is that the template arguments can have arbitrary complexity of name qualification requirements such that we need to save the associtate string
6696  // generated once after all of the required name qualification (of the template arguments) has been figured out.
6697 
6698  // The point is to save the generated name of the class declaration, correctly name qualified (with all template parameters name qualified) so that it can
6699  // be used directly (as a string) in the unparsing. The call to "addToNameMap()" is the key part that saves the name of the template instantiation.
6700 
6701  // Currently the base class references the shared template class instantiation (so this might be the root of the problem as well).
6702  // If sharing is the issue, then generateding a strring to hold the name of the class with ccntext depenent template argument name
6703  // qualification would be the solution (just as it is for shared types).
6704 
6705 
6706  // Called similar to traverseTemplatedFunction(functionRefExp,templateInstantiationFunctionDeclaration,currentScope,currentStatement)
6707 
6708  ASSERT_not_null(baseClass);
6709  ASSERT_not_null(nodeReference);
6710  ASSERT_not_null(currentScope);
6711  ASSERT_not_null(positionStatement);
6712 
6713 #if 0
6714  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Inside of traverseTemplatedClass baseClass = %p currentScope = %p = %s \n",baseClass,currentScope,currentScope->class_name().c_str());
6715 #endif

6719 
6720  bool skipThisClass = false;
6721  if (skipThisClass == false)
6722  {
6723  SgTemplateInstantiationDecl* templateInstantiationClassDeclaration = isSgTemplateInstantiationDecl(baseClass->get_base_class());
6724  if (templateInstantiationClassDeclaration != NULL)
6725  {
6726 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0

6728 #endif
6729  evaluateTemplateInstantiationDeclaration(templateInstantiationClassDeclaration,currentScope,positionStatement);
6730  }
6731 
6732  SgUnparse_Info* unparseInfoPointer = new SgUnparse_Info();
6733  ASSERT_not_null(unparseInfoPointer);
6734  unparseInfoPointer->set_outputCompilerGeneratedStatements();
6735 
6736  // Avoid unpasing the class definition when unparseing the type.
6737  unparseInfoPointer->set_SkipClassDefinition();

6743  unparseInfoPointer->set_inEmbeddedDecl();

6745  unparseInfoPointer->set_SkipClassSpecifier();
6746 
6747 #if 0
6748  // DQ (4/12/2019): Test2019_342.C and test2019_350.C demonstrate that this needs to be more carefully supported.
6749  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("############################################################################################################################# \n");
6750  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In traverseTemplatedClass(): Need to supress name qualification in the generated string to avoid redundant name qualification \n");
6751  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("############################################################################################################################# \n");
6752 #endif
6753  unparseInfoPointer->set_SkipNameQualification();
6754 
6755 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
6756  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In traverseTemplatedClass(): nodeReference = %p = %s \n",nodeReference,nodeReference->class_name().c_str());
6757 #endif
6758 
6759  // DQ (3/13/2019): Not setting the reference_node_for_qualification, may be the best way to make sure
6760  // we don't get a name qualification prefix.
6761  // Associate the unparsing of this type with the statement or scope where it occures.
6762  // This is the key to use in the lookup of the qualified name. But this is the correct key....
6763  unparseInfoPointer->set_reference_node_for_qualification(nodeReference);

6770 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0

6773  string classNameString = globalUnparseToString(templateInstantiationClassDeclaration,unparseInfoPointer);

6795  delete unparseInfoPointer;
6796  }

6800 #endif
6801  }

7497  // 1) Base class names

7499  // 3) Types referenced by variables

7501  // 5) Return types referenced by functions (including covariant types for member functions)
7502  // 6) References to functions thrown by functions
7503  // 7) Namespaces referenced by SgUsingDirectiveStatement IR nodes
7504  // 8) Variables and declarations reference from SgUsingDeclarationStatement IR nodes
7505  // 9) Functions reference by SgFunctionRefExp IR nodes
7506  // 10) Functions reference by SgMemberFunctionRefExp IR nodes
7507  // 11) Variable reference by SgVarRefExp IR nodes
7508  // 12) Template arguments (and default template parameter specifications)
7509  // 13) Template parameters?
7510  // 14) Function declarations
7511  // 15) Member function declarations
7512  // 16) Typedef declarations
7513  // 17) Throw exception lists
7514  // 18) A number of expressions (listed below)
7515  // SgVarRefExp
7516  // SgFunctionRefExp
7517  // SgMemberFunctionRefExp
7518  // SgConstructorInitializer
7519  // SgNewExp
7520  // SgCastExp

7526  // The use of name qualification in types is a complicated because types are shared and the same type can
7527  // have it's template arguments qualified differently depending on where it is referenced. This is an
7528  // issue for all references to types containing template arguments and not just where SgInitializedName
7529  // are used. Since name qualification of the same type can only vary at most from statement to statement
7530  // in some cases likely only from scope to scope) we need only associate names to statements (see note 1).
7531  // I would like to for now use scopes as the finest level of resolution.
7532  // The solution:
7533  // 1) Support a test for which types are effected. a member function of SgType will evaluate if
7534  // a type uses template arguments or subtypes using template arguments and if these could require
7535  // name qualification.
7536  // 2) A map will be created in each scope (or maybe statement) for types used in that scope (or statement)
7537  // which will store the computed name of the type (evaluated as part of the name qualification support;
7538  // called immediately at the start of the unparsing of each SgFile). The SgType pointer will be used
7539  // as the key into the map of SgType to names (stored as strings).
7540  // 3) The unparser will check for entries in the associated map and use the stringified type names if they
7541  // are available. This can be done at the top level of the unparseType() function.
7542 
7543  // Note 1: A forward declaraion of a function (and maybe a class) can happen in a scope that does not allow a defining
7544  // declaration and when this happens the name qualification of that function is undefined. However after a
7545  // forward declaration in a scope permitting a defining declaration, the function name must be qualified as per
7546  // usual name qualification rules.
7547

7551  // Ititially it is NULL, but specific cases can set this so that the associated declaration
7552  // we be recorded as referenced. This is important for test2012_164.C, where a variable declaration
7553  // generates a reference to a type that at first must not use a qualified name (since there is no
7554  // explicit forward declaration for the type (a class/struct). This is a facinating case since
7555  // the scope of the declaration is the outer namespace from where it is first implicitly referenced
7556  // via a variable declaration. This is part of debugging test2005_133.C (of which test2012_16[3-5].C
7557  // are simpler cases.

11300 #define DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE 0
11301 
11302 // Dealing with nonreal's scope: the scope is where the nonreal is instantiated this code either:
11303 // - Uses the scope of the associated template, if it exists
11304 // - Traverse nonreal parent using while loop, else
11305 SgScopeStatement * traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(SgDeclarationStatement * declaration) {
11306  SgScopeStatement * scope = declaration->get_scope();
11307  ASSERT_not_null(scope);
11308 
11309 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE
11310  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope():\n");
11311  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- declaration = %p (%s)\n", declaration, declaration->class_name().c_str());
11312  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- scope = %p (%s)\n", scope, scope->class_name().c_str());
11313 #endif
11314 
11315  SgNonrealDecl * nrdecl = isSgNonrealDecl(declaration);
11316  while (nrdecl != NULL) {
11317  if (nrdecl->get_templateDeclaration() == NULL) {
11318  SgDeclarationScope * decl_scope = isSgDeclarationScope(nrdecl->get_scope());
11319  ASSERT_not_null(decl_scope);
11320 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE
11321  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- decl_scope = %p (%s)\n", decl_scope,decl_scope->class_name().c_str());
11322 #endif
11323 
11324  SgNode * decl_scope_parent = decl_scope->get_parent();
11325  ASSERT_not_null(decl_scope_parent);
11326 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE
11327  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- decl_scope_parent = %p (%s)\n", decl_scope_parent, decl_scope_parent->class_name().c_str());
11328 #endif
11329 
11330  SgTemplateClassDeclaration * tcdecl_parent = isSgTemplateClassDeclaration(decl_scope_parent);
11331  SgTemplateFunctionDeclaration * tfdecl_parent = isSgTemplateFunctionDeclaration(decl_scope_parent);
11332  SgTemplateMemberFunctionDeclaration * tmfdecl_parent = isSgTemplateMemberFunctionDeclaration(decl_scope_parent);
11333  SgTemplateTypedefDeclaration * ttddecl_parent = isSgTemplateTypedefDeclaration(decl_scope_parent);
11334  SgTemplateVariableDeclaration * tvdecl_parent = isSgTemplateVariableDeclaration(decl_scope_parent);
11335  SgNonrealDecl * nr_parent = isSgNonrealDecl(decl_scope_parent);
11336  if (nr_parent != NULL) {
11337  ROSE_ASSERT(nr_parent != nrdecl); // LOOP in the nonreal declaration: forbidden
11338  nrdecl = nr_parent;
11339 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE
11340  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- nrdecl = %p (%s)\n", nrdecl, nrdecl->class_name().c_str());
11341 #endif
11342  } else {
11343  ROSE_ASSERT(tcdecl_parent || tfdecl_parent || tmfdecl_parent || ttddecl_parent || tvdecl_parent);
11344  break;
11345  }
11346  } else {
11347 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE
11348  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- nrdecl->get_templateDeclaration() = %p (%s)\n", nrdecl->get_templateDeclaration(), nrdecl->get_templateDeclaration()->class_name().c_str());
11349 #endif
11350 
11351  scope = nrdecl->get_templateDeclaration()->get_scope();
11352  ASSERT_not_null(scope);
11353 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TRAVERSE_NONREAL_FOR_SCOPE
11354  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- scope = %p (%s)\n", scope, scope->class_name().c_str());
11355 #endif
11356 
11357  break;
11358  }
11359  }
11360 
11361  return scope;
11362 }

11364 // ************************************************************************************
11365 // These overloaded functions, setNameQualification(), support references to IR
11366 // nodes that require name qualification. Each function inserts a qualified name
11367 // (string) into a map stored as a static data member in SgNode. For each IR node
11368 // that is qualified, the reference to the IR node carries the name qualification
11369 // (is used as a key in the map of qualified names). There are two maps, one for
11370 // the qualification of names and one for qualification of types. Note that, since
11371 // types are shared, it is more clear that the type can't carry the qualified name
11372 // because it could be different at each location where the type is referenced; thus
11373 // the reference to the type carries the qualified name (via the map). The case of
11374 // why named IR constructs have to have there qualified name in the IR node referencing
11375 // the named construct is similar.
11376 //
11377 // They are only a few IR nodes that reference IR nodes that can be qualified:
11378 // SgExpression IR nodes:
11379 // SgVarRefExp
11380 // SgFunctionRefExp
11381 // SgMemberFunctionRefExp
11382 // SgConstructorInitializer
11383 // SgNewExp
11384 // SgCastExp
11385 // SgSizeOfOp
11386 // SgTypeIdOp
11387 //
11388 // SgDeclarationStatement IR nodes:
11389 // SgFunctionDeclaration (for the function name)
11390 // SgFunctionDeclaration (for the return type)
11391 // SgUsingDeclarationStatement (for references to a declaration (e.g. namespace or class))
11392 // SgUsingDeclarationStatement (for references to a SgInitializedName)
11393 // SgUsingDirectiveStatement
11394 // SgVariableDeclaration
11395 // SgTypedefDeclaration
11396 // SgClassDeclaration
11397 // SgEnumDeclaration
11398 //
11399 // SgStatement IR nodes:
11400 // SgForInitStatement is not a problems since it is a list of SgInitializedName
11401 //
11402 // SgLocatedNode nodes:
11403 // SgInitializedName
11404 //
11405 // SgSupport nodes:
11406 // SgBaseClass
11407 // SgTemplateArgument
11408 //
11409 // Other (not yet supported) IR nodes recognized to reference types that could require name
11410 // qualification support:
11411 // SgExpression IR nodes:
11412 //
11413 // And maybe also:
11414 // SgPseudoDestructorRefExp
11415 // SgTemplateParameter
11416 //
11417 // Note also that name qualifiction can be required on expressions that are a part of
11418 // the originalExpressionTree that represent the expanded representation from constant
11419 // folding. Thus we have to make a recursive call on all valid originalExpressionTree
11420 // pointers where they are present:
11421 // SgBinaryOp
11422 // SgValueExp
11423 // SgFunctionRefExp
11424 // SgValueExp
11425 // SgCastExp
11426 // ************************************************************************************
11427 
11428 
11429 // DQ (4/20/2019): For where the input is a type (SgPointerMemberType) we need to pass in a
11430 // referenceNode for what will become the key in the map for the name qualification prefix.
11431 void NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualificationOnClassOf ( SgPointerMemberType* pointerMemberType, SgDeclarationStatement* declaration, int amountOfNameQualificationRequired )
11432  {
11433  // DQ (4/19/2019): Adding support for chains of SpPointerMemberType types (requires type traversal).
11434 
11435  // Setup call to refactored code.
11436  int outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
11437  bool outputGlobalQualification = false;
11438  bool outputTypeEvaluation = false;
11439 
11440 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11441  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualification(SgPointerMemberType*) \n");
11442 #endif
11443 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
11444  printf("In setNameQualification(SgPointerMemberType*): calling setNameQualificationSupport() \n");
11445 #endif
11446 
11447  SgScopeStatement * scope = traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(declaration);
11448  string qualifier = setNameQualificationSupport(scope,amountOfNameQualificationRequired, outputNameQualificationLength, outputGlobalQualification, outputTypeEvaluation);
