11572 void
11573 NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(SgVarRefExp* varRefExp, SgVariableDeclaration* variableDeclaration, int amountOfNameQualificationRequired)
11574  {
11575  // This is where we hide the details of translating the intepretation of the amountOfNameQualificationRequired
11576  // which can be greater than the number of nested scopes to a representation that is bounded by the number of
11577  // nested scopes and sets the global qualification to be true. If I decide I don't like this here, then we
11578  // might find a way to handling this point more directly later. This at least gets it set properly in the AST.
11579 
11580  // Setup call to refactored code.
11581  int outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
11582  bool outputGlobalQualification = false;
11583  bool outputTypeEvaluation = false;
11584 
11585  // DQ (7/31/2012): check if this is a SgVarRefExp that is associated with a class that is un-named, if so then
11586  // supress the name qualification (which would use the internally generated name). Note that all constructs
11587  // that are un-named have names generated internally for them so that we can support the AST merge process
11588  // and generally reference multiple un-named constructs that may exist in a single compilation unit.
11589  // SgClassDeclaration* classDeclaration = isSgClassDeclaration(varRefExp->parent());
11590 
11591  ASSERT_not_null(varRefExp);
11592  SgBinaryOp* dotExp = isSgDotExp(varRefExp->get_parent());
11593  SgBinaryOp* arrowExp = isSgArrowExp(varRefExp->get_parent());
11594 
11595 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11596  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualification(SgVarRefExp*) \n");
11597 #endif
11598 
11599 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11600  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("dotExp = %p arrowExp = %p \n",dotExp,arrowExp);
11601 #endif
11602 
11603  SgVarRefExp* possibleClassVarRefExp = NULL;
11604  if (dotExp != NULL)
11605  {
11606 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11607  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Note that this code is overly sensitive to the local structure of the AST expressions \n");
11608 #endif
11609  possibleClassVarRefExp = isSgVarRefExp(dotExp->get_lhs_operand());
11610 
11611  if (possibleClassVarRefExp == NULL)
11612  {
11613  SgPntrArrRefExp* possiblePntrArrRefExp = isSgPntrArrRefExp(dotExp->get_lhs_operand());
11614  if (possiblePntrArrRefExp != NULL)
11615  {
11616  possibleClassVarRefExp = isSgVarRefExp(possiblePntrArrRefExp->get_lhs_operand());
11617  }
11618  }
11619  }
11620 
11621  if (arrowExp != NULL)
11622  {
11623 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11624  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Note that this code is overly sensitive to the local structure of the AST expressions \n");
11625 #endif
11626  possibleClassVarRefExp = isSgVarRefExp(arrowExp->get_lhs_operand());
11627 
11628  if (possibleClassVarRefExp == NULL)
11629  {
11630  SgPntrArrRefExp* possiblePntrArrRefExp = isSgPntrArrRefExp(arrowExp->get_lhs_operand());
11631  if (possiblePntrArrRefExp != NULL)
11632  {
11633  possibleClassVarRefExp = isSgVarRefExp(possiblePntrArrRefExp->get_lhs_operand());
11634  }
11635  }
11636  }
11637 
11638 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11639  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("possibleClassVarRefExp = %p \n",possibleClassVarRefExp);
11640 #endif
11641 
11642  SgClassType* classType = NULL;
11643  if (possibleClassVarRefExp != NULL)
11644  {
11645  SgType* varRefExpType = possibleClassVarRefExp->get_type();
11646  ASSERT_not_null(varRefExpType);
11647 
11648 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11649  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExpType = %p = %s \n",varRefExpType,varRefExpType->class_name().c_str());
11650 #endif
11651 
11652  // DQ (8/2/2012): test2007_06.C and test2012_156.C show that we need to strip past the typedefs.
11653  // Note that we don't want to strip typedefs, since that could take us past public types and into private types.
11654  // SgType* possibleClassType = varRefExpType->stripType(SgType::STRIP_MODIFIER_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_REFERENCE_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_POINTER_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_ARRAY_TYPE); // Excluding SgType::STRIP_TYPEDEF_TYPE
11655  SgType* possibleClassType = varRefExpType->stripType(SgType::STRIP_MODIFIER_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_REFERENCE_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_RVALUE_REFERENCE_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_POINTER_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_ARRAY_TYPE|SgType::STRIP_TYPEDEF_TYPE);
11656  classType = isSgClassType(possibleClassType);
11657  }
11658 
11659 
11660  bool isAnUnamedConstructs = false;
11661  if (classType != NULL)
11662  {
11663 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11664  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): classType = %p = %s \n",classType,classType->class_name().c_str());
11665 #endif
11666  SgClassDeclaration* classDeclaration = isSgClassDeclaration(classType->get_declaration());
11667  ASSERT_not_null(classDeclaration);
11668 
11669 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11670  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): classDeclaration = %p = %s \n",classDeclaration,classDeclaration->class_name().c_str());
11671 #endif
11672 
11673  // DQ (9/4/2012): I don't think that the defining declaration should have to exist.
11674  // However this was a previously passing test for all of the regression tests.
11675  // ASSERT_not_null(classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration());
11676  if (classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() != NULL)
11677  {
11678  SgClassDeclaration* definingClassDeclaration = isSgClassDeclaration(classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration());
11679  if (definingClassDeclaration == NULL)
11680  {
11681  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("ERROR: definingClassDeclaration == NULL: classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() = %p = %s \n",classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration(),classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration()->class_name().c_str());
11682  }
11683  ASSERT_not_null(definingClassDeclaration);
11684 
11685  // This should be true so assert this here.
11686  ROSE_ASSERT(classDeclaration->get_isUnNamed() == definingClassDeclaration->get_isUnNamed());
11687  }
11688  else
11689  {
11690 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11691  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: classDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() == NULL: This was a previously passing test, but not now that we have force SgTemplateTypes to be handled in the local type table. \n");
11692 #endif
11693  }
11694 
11695  if (classDeclaration->get_isUnNamed() == true)
11696  {
11697  isAnUnamedConstructs = true;
11698  }
11699  }
11700 
11701 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11702  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): isAnUnamedConstructs = %s \n",isAnUnamedConstructs ? "true" : "false");
11703 #endif
11704 
11705  // DQ (7/31/2012): If this is an un-named construct then no qualifiaction can be used since there is no associated name.
11706  if (isAnUnamedConstructs == false)
11707  {
11708  SgScopeStatement * scope = traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(variableDeclaration);
11709  string qualifier = setNameQualificationSupport(scope,amountOfNameQualificationRequired, outputNameQualificationLength, outputGlobalQualification, outputTypeEvaluation);
11710 
11711  varRefExp->set_global_qualification_required(outputGlobalQualification);
11712  varRefExp->set_name_qualification_length(outputNameQualificationLength);
11713 
11714  // There should be no type evaluation required for a variable reference, as I recall.
11715  ROSE_ASSERT(outputTypeEvaluation == false);
11716  varRefExp->set_type_elaboration_required(outputTypeEvaluation);
11717 
11718 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11719  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExp->get_name_qualification_length() = %d \n",varRefExp->get_name_qualification_length());
11720  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExp->get_type_elaboration_required() = %s \n",varRefExp->get_type_elaboration_required() ? "true" : "false");
11721  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExp->get_global_qualification_required() = %s \n",varRefExp->get_global_qualification_required() ? "true" : "false");
11722 #endif
11723 
11724  if (qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(varRefExp) == qualifiedNameMapForNames.end())
11725  {
11726 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11727  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Inserting qualifier for name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),varRefExp,varRefExp->class_name().c_str());
11728 #endif
11729 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
11730  printf("TEST 5: Inserting qualifier for name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),varRefExp,varRefExp->class_name().c_str());
11731 #endif
11732  qualifiedNameMapForNames.insert(std::pair<SgNode*,std::string>(varRefExp,qualifier));
11733  }
11734  else
11735  {
11736  // DQ (6/20/2011): We see this case in test2011_87.C.
11737  // If it already existes then overwrite the existing information.
11738  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>::iterator i = qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(varRefExp);
11739  ROSE_ASSERT (i != qualifiedNameMapForNames.end());
11740 
11741 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11742  string previousQualifier = i->second.c_str();
11743  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: test 2: replacing previousQualifier = %s with new qualifier = %s \n",previousQualifier.c_str(),qualifier.c_str());
11744 #endif
11745  if (i->second != qualifier)
11746  {
11747  // DQ (7/23/2011): Multiple uses of the SgVarRefExp expression in SgArrayType will cause
11748  // the name qualification to be reset each time. This is OK since it is used to build
11749  // the type name that will be saved.
11750  i->second = qualifier;
11751 #if 0
11752  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Note: name in qualifiedNameMapForNames already exists and is different... \n");
11753 #endif
11754  }
11755  }
11756  }
11757  else
11758  {
11759  SgScopeStatement * scope = traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(variableDeclaration);
11760  string qualifier = setNameQualificationSupport(scope,amountOfNameQualificationRequired, outputNameQualificationLength, outputGlobalQualification, outputTypeEvaluation);
11761 
11762  varRefExp->set_global_qualification_required(outputGlobalQualification);
11763  varRefExp->set_name_qualification_length(outputNameQualificationLength);
11764 
11765  // There should be no type evaluation required for a variable reference, as I recall.
11766  ROSE_ASSERT(outputTypeEvaluation == false);
11767  varRefExp->set_type_elaboration_required(outputTypeEvaluation);
11768 
11769 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11770  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExp->get_name_qualification_length() = %d \n",varRefExp->get_name_qualification_length());
11771  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExp->get_type_elaboration_required() = %s \n",varRefExp->get_type_elaboration_required() ? "true" : "false");
11772  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): varRefExp->get_global_qualification_required() = %s \n",varRefExp->get_global_qualification_required() ? "true" : "false");
11773 #endif
11774 
11775  if (qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(varRefExp) == qualifiedNameMapForNames.end())
11776  {
11777 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11778  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Inserting qualifier for name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),varRefExp,varRefExp->class_name().c_str());
11779 #endif
11780 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
11781  printf("TEST 6: Inserting qualifier for name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),varRefExp,varRefExp->class_name().c_str());
11782 #endif
11783  qualifiedNameMapForNames.insert(std::pair<SgNode*,std::string>(varRefExp,qualifier));
11784  }
11785  else
11786  {
11787  // DQ (6/20/2011): We see this case in test2011_87.C.
11788  // If it already existes then overwrite the existing information.
11789  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>::iterator i = qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(varRefExp);
11790  ROSE_ASSERT (i != qualifiedNameMapForNames.end());
11791 
11792 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11793  string previousQualifier = i->second.c_str();
11794  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: test 2: replacing previousQualifier = %s with new qualifier = %s \n",previousQualifier.c_str(),qualifier.c_str());
11795 #endif
11796  if (i->second != qualifier)
11797  {
11798  // DQ (7/23/2011): Multiple uses of the SgVarRefExp expression in SgArrayType will cause
11799  // the name qualification to be reset each time. This is OK since it is used to build
11800  // the type name that will be saved.

11852  // Look for friend declaration on both declaration (defining and non-defining).
11853  bool isFriend = false;
11854  if (functionDeclaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() != NULL)
11855  {
11856  isFriend = isFriend || functionDeclaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration()->get_declarationModifier().isFriend();
11857  }
11858  if (functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() != NULL)
11859  {
11860  isFriend = isFriend || functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration()->get_declarationModifier().isFriend();
11861  }
11862 
11863 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11864  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("isFriend = %s \n",isFriend ? "true" : "false");
11865  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() = %p \n",functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration());
11866 #endif
11867 
11868  // DQ (4/2/2014): After discusion with Markus, this is a problem that is a significant
11869  // issue and requires a general solution that would be useful more generally than just
11870  // to this specific problem. We need to build a data stucture and hide it behind a
11871  // class with an appropriate API. The data structure should have a container of
11872  // non-defining declarations for each first-non-defining declaration. Thus we would
11873  // have a way to find all of the non-defining declarations associated with any
11874  // function and thus query if one of them was declard in a scope that defined its
11875  // scope definatively. This class should be a part of an AST Information sort of
11876  // object that we would use to collect similar analysis information that would be
11877  // seperate from the AST, but might be used with the AST for certain purposes
11878  // (e.g. removning all functions including all associated non-defining declarations).
11879 
11880  // DQ (4/6/2014): Adding support for new analysis results. Fails for test2013_242.C.
11881  ASSERT_not_null(declarationSet);
11882  if (qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(functionRefExp) == qualifiedNameMapForNames.end())
11883  {
11884 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11885  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Inserting qualifier for (SgFunctionRefExp) name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),functionRefExp,functionRefExp->class_name().c_str());
11886 #endif
11887 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
11888  printf("TEST 7: Inserting qualifier for (SgFunctionRefExp) name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),functionRefExp,functionRefExp->class_name().c_str());
11889 #endif
11890  qualifiedNameMapForNames.insert(std::pair<SgNode*,std::string>(functionRefExp,qualifier));
11891 
11892 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11893  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Testing name in map: for SgFunctionRefExp = %p qualified name = %s \n",functionRefExp,functionRefExp->get_qualified_name_prefix().str());
11894  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("SgNode::get_globalQualifiedNameMapForNames().size() = %" PRIuPTR " \n",SgNode::get_globalQualifiedNameMapForNames().size());
11895 #endif
11896  }
11897  else
11898  {
11899  // If it already existes then overwrite the existing information.
11900  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>::iterator i = qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(functionRefExp);
11901  ROSE_ASSERT (i != qualifiedNameMapForNames.end());
11902 
11903 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
11904  string previousQualifier = i->second.c_str();
11905  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: test 3: replacing previousQualifier = %s with new qualifier = %s \n",previousQualifier.c_str(),qualifier.c_str());
11906 #endif
11907  if (i->second != qualifier)
11908  {
11909  // DQ (3/15/2019): We need to disable the assertion below because it can happen (see Cxx11_tests/test2019_214.C).
11910  i->second = qualifier;
11911  }

12233 NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification ( SgFunctionDeclaration* functionDeclaration, int amountOfNameQualificationRequired )
12234  {
12235  // This takes only a SgFunctionDeclaration since it is where we locate the name qualification information AND
12236  // is the correct scope from which to iterate backwards through scopes to evaluate what name qualification is required.
12237 
12238  // Setup call to refactored code.
12239  int outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
12240  bool outputGlobalQualification = false;
12241  bool outputTypeEvaluation = false;
12242 
12243  // mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("\n************************************************ \n");
12244 
12245 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12246  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualification(SgFunctionDeclaration*): functionDeclaration = %p \n",functionDeclaration);
12247  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- functionDeclaration->get_name() = %s \n",functionDeclaration->get_name().str());
12248  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- amountOfNameQualificationRequired = %d \n",amountOfNameQualificationRequired);
12249  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() = %p \n",functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration());
12250  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- functionDeclaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() = %p \n",functionDeclaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration());
12251 #endif
12252 
12253  SgScopeStatement * scope = traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(functionDeclaration);
12254 
12255  // DQ (5/28/2022): The problem is that for a member function build from scratch and added to the AST,
12256  // there is one level of name qualification too mucyh being requested, and it is an error to use global
12257  // qualification in these cases with at least GNU v10.
12258  // Introduce error checking to detect when there is too much name qualification being requested.
12259  // This needs to be fixed correctly before this point.
12260  ROSE_ASSERT(scope != NULL);
12261  SgScopeStatement* outer_scope = scope->get_scope();
12262  if (isSgGlobal(outer_scope) != NULL)
12263  {
12264  amountOfNameQualificationRequired = 1;
12265  }
12266 
12267  string qualifier = setNameQualificationSupport(scope,amountOfNameQualificationRequired, outputNameQualificationLength, outputGlobalQualification, outputTypeEvaluation);
12268 
12269 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12270  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualification(SgFunctionDeclaration*): scope = %p qualifier = %s \n",scope,qualifier.c_str());
12271  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- outputGlobalQualification = %s \n",outputGlobalQualification ? "true" : "false");
12272  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- outputNameQualificationLength = %d \n",outputNameQualificationLength);
12273  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- amountOfNameQualificationRequired = %d \n",amountOfNameQualificationRequired);
12274 #endif
12275 
12276  // DQ (9/7/2014): Added suppor for where this is a template member or non-member function declaration and we need to genrate the name with the associated template header.
12277  string template_header;
12278  SgTemplateFunctionDeclaration* templateFunctionDeclaration = isSgTemplateFunctionDeclaration(functionDeclaration);
12279  SgTemplateMemberFunctionDeclaration* templateMemberFunctionDeclaration = isSgTemplateMemberFunctionDeclaration(functionDeclaration);
12280  bool buildTemplateHeaderString = (templateFunctionDeclaration != NULL || templateMemberFunctionDeclaration != NULL);
12281  if (buildTemplateHeaderString == true)
12282  {
12283  // DQ (9/7/2014): First idea, but not likely to work...and too complex.
12284  // Note that another aspect of this implementation might be that we save a set of template class
12285  // declarations so that we can match types in the function's parameter list against the template class declaration
12286  // set so that we know when to build function parameter types as template types vs. template instantiation types.
12287  // This would require that we save a more complex data structure than a simple string. It is also not clear if
12288  // all references to a template class instantiation could be assumed to be references to it's template declaration?
12289  // Or maybe the problem is that there is some other function parameter lis that we need to consult.
12290 
12291  // DQ (9/7/2014): Better:
12292  // A better solution would be to make sure that we generate type in the EDG/ROSE translation using the template
12293  // function's paramter list associated with the first non-defining declaration (instead of the one being generated
12294  // as part of building the defining declaration (which is using the same a_routine_ptr as that used to build the
12295  // template instantiation. As a result we a mixing the types in the defining template declaration with that of the
12296  // defining template instantiation (which is always wrong). So the simple solution is to just use the types from
12297  // the non-defining template member or non-member function declaration. The same should apply to the function
12298  // return type. This is the simplest solution to date.
12299 
12300  // DQ (9/8/2014): The best solution was to translate the defining non-template function declarations when we saw them
12301  // as defining declarations, but only put the non-defining declaration into the class template (to match the normalization
12302  // done by EDG) and then attach the defining template declaration ahead of the first associated template instantiation.
12303  // This appears to work well and will soon be evaluated for further tests.
12304  template_header = setTemplateHeaderNameQualificationSupport(functionDeclaration->get_scope(),amountOfNameQualificationRequired);
12305  }
12306 
12307 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12308  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): functionDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().isFriend() = %s \n",functionDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().isFriend() ? "true" : "false");
12309  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): outputNameQualificationLength = %d \n",outputNameQualificationLength);
12310  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): outputGlobalQualification = %s \n",outputGlobalQualification ? "true" : "false");
12311 #endif
12312 
12313  // DQ (2/18/2024): Note that there may not be a nondefining declaration, and then we still don't want to output the global name qualification.
12314  // DQ (2/16/2013): Note that test2013_67.C is a case where name qualification of the friend function is required.
12315  // I think it is because it is a non defining declaration instead of a defining declaration.
12316  // DQ (3/31/2012): I don't think that global qualification is allowed for friend functions (so test for this).
12317  // test2012_57.C is an example of this issue.
12318  // if (outputGlobalQualification == true && functionDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().isFriend() == true)
12319  // if ( (outputGlobalQualification == true) && (functionDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().isFriend() == true) && (functionDeclaration == functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration()))
12320  if ( (outputGlobalQualification == true) &&
12321  (functionDeclaration->get_declarationModifier().isFriend() == true) &&
12322  ( (functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration() == NULL) || (functionDeclaration == functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration()) ) )
12323  {
12324 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12325  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: We can't specify global qualification of friend function (qualifier reset to be empty string) \n");
12326 #endif
12327  // Note that I think this might only be an issue where outputNameQualificationLength == 0.
12328  ROSE_ASSERT (outputNameQualificationLength == 0);
12329 
12330  // Reset the values (and the qualifier string).
12331  // outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
12332  outputGlobalQualification = false;
12333  qualifier = "";
12334  }
12335 
12336  functionDeclaration->set_global_qualification_required(outputGlobalQualification);
12337  functionDeclaration->set_name_qualification_length(outputNameQualificationLength);
12338  functionDeclaration->set_type_elaboration_required(outputTypeEvaluation);
12339 
12340  // There should be no type evaluation required for a variable reference, as I recall.
12341  ROSE_ASSERT(outputTypeEvaluation == false);
12342 
12343 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12344  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): functionDeclaration->get_name_qualification_length() = %d \n",functionDeclaration->get_name_qualification_length());
12345  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): functionDeclaration->get_type_elaboration_required() = %s \n",functionDeclaration->get_type_elaboration_required() ? "true" : "false");
12346  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): functionDeclaration->get_global_qualification_required() = %s \n",functionDeclaration->get_global_qualification_required() ? "true" : "false");

12349  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): functionDeclaration = %p definingDeclaration() = %p \n",functionDeclaration,functionDeclaration->get_definingDeclaration());
12350 #endif
12351 
12352  if (qualifiedNameMapForNames.find(functionDeclaration) == qualifiedNameMapForNames.end())
12353  {
12354 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12355  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Inserting qualifier for name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),functionDeclaration,functionDeclaration->class_name().c_str());
12356 #endif
12357 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
12358  printf("TEST 13: Inserting qualifier for name = %s into list at IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),functionDeclaration,functionDeclaration->class_name().c_str());

12360  qualifiedNameMapForNames.insert(std::pair<SgNode*,std::string>(functionDeclaration,qualifier));

12370  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- functionDeclaration = %p = %s name = %s \n",functionDeclaration,functionDeclaration->class_name().c_str(),functionDeclaration->get_name().str());

12375  if (buildTemplateHeaderString == true)

12665 // DQ (7/7/2021): Added function to trim the leading "::" from the qualified name.
12666 static void trimLeadingGlobalNameQualification(std::string &s)
12667  {
12668  s.erase(s.begin(), std::find_if(s.begin(), s.end(), [](unsigned char ch) { return ch != ':'; }));
12669  }

12671 // DQ (3/31/2019): Renamed this function to make it more clear now that we have two versions, one to name
12672 // qualify the SgInitializedName and one to name qualify the type used in the SgInitializedName.
12673 // DQ (8/4/2012): Added support to permit global qualification to be skipped explicitly (see test2012_164.C and test2012_165.C for examples where this is important).
12674 void
12675 NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName* initializedName,SgDeclarationStatement* declaration, int amountOfNameQualificationRequired, bool skipGlobalQualification)
12676  {
12677  // This is used to set the name qualification on the type referenced by the SgInitializedName, and not on the SgInitializedName IR node itself.
12678 
12679  // Setup call to refactored code.
12680  int outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
12681  bool outputGlobalQualification = false;
12682  bool outputTypeEvaluation = false;
12683 
12684  // DQ (4/28/2019): Added assertion.
12685  ASSERT_not_null(initializedName);
12686 
12687 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12688  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): initializedName = %p = %s \n",initializedName,initializedName->get_name().str());
12689 #endif
12690 
12691  // DQ (4/28/2019): Added assertion.
12692  ASSERT_not_null(declaration);
12693 
12694  SgScopeStatement * scope = traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(declaration);
12695  string qualifier = setNameQualificationSupport(scope,amountOfNameQualificationRequired, outputNameQualificationLength, outputGlobalQualification, outputTypeEvaluation);
12696 
12697 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12698  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): qualifier = %s \n",qualifier.c_str());
12699 #endif
12700 
12701 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12702  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("declaration = %p = %s \n",declaration,declaration->class_name().c_str());
12703  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("declaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() = %p \n",declaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration());
12704  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("declaration->get_definingDeclaration() = %p \n",declaration->get_definingDeclaration());
12705 #endif
12706 
12707  // unsigned int sourceSequenceForInitializedName = initializedName->get_file_info()->get_source_sequence_number();
12708  // unsigned int sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration = declaration->get_file_info()->get_source_sequence_number();
12709 
12710  // DQ (5/15/2018): Test code test2018_65.C demonstrates that we need to suppress the
12711  // name qualification of the type if the defining declaration has not been seen yet.
12712  unsigned int sourceSequenceForInitializedName = 0;
12713  unsigned int sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration = 0;
12714  SgDeclarationStatement* definingDeclaration = declaration->get_definingDeclaration();
12715  if (definingDeclaration != NULL)
12716  {
12717  // If we have a defining declaration, then query the source sequence numbers.
12718  ASSERT_not_null(initializedName->get_file_info());
12719  ASSERT_not_null(declaration->get_file_info());
12720  sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration = definingDeclaration->get_file_info()->get_source_sequence_number();
12721  sourceSequenceForInitializedName = initializedName->get_file_info()->get_source_sequence_number();
12722  }
12723  else
12724  {
12725  // DQ (7/7/2021): If these is no defining declaration then use the nondefining declaration (important for typedefs and namespaces).
12726  sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration = declaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration()->get_file_info()->get_source_sequence_number();
12727  sourceSequenceForInitializedName = initializedName->get_file_info()->get_source_sequence_number();
12728  }
12729 
12730 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12731  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("sourceSequenceForInitializedName = %u \n",sourceSequenceForInitializedName);
12732  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration = %u \n",sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration);
12733 #endif
12734 
12735  // DQ (7/7/2021): For a transformation (e.g. outlining), the values will be zero, so test for this explicitly
12736  // and if so, then we want to output the name qualification. Note that zero for the source sequence implaies
12737  // that this is a transformation.
12738  bool outputNameQualification = (sourceSequenceForInitializedName == 0) || sourceSequenceForTypeDeclaration < sourceSequenceForInitializedName;
12739 
12740  // DQ (5/15/2018): If this is a SgTemplateInstantiationTypedefDeclaration then output the name qualification.
12741  if (isSgTemplateInstantiationTypedefDeclaration(declaration) != NULL)
12742  {
12743  outputNameQualification = true;
12744  }
12745 
12746 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12747  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): skipGlobalQualification = %s \n",skipGlobalQualification ? "true" : "false");
12748  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): outputNameQualification = %s \n",outputNameQualification ? "true" : "false");
12749  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): qualifier = %s \n",qualifier.c_str());
12750 #endif
12751 
12752  if (skipGlobalQualification == true && outputNameQualification == false)
12753  {
12754 // #ifdef ROSE_DEBUG_NEW_EDG_ROSE_CONNECTION
12755 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12756  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(SgInitializedName* initializedName): skipGlobalQualification has caused global qualification to be ignored \n");
12757 #endif
12758  qualifier = "";
12759 
12760  outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
12761  outputGlobalQualification = false;
12762 
12763  // Note clear if this is what we want.
12764  outputTypeEvaluation = false;
12765  }
12766  else if (skipGlobalQualification)
12767  {
12768  trimLeadingGlobalNameQualification(qualifier);
12769  }
12770 
12771 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || 0
12772  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): after modification: qualifier = %s \n",qualifier.c_str());
12773 #endif
12774 
12775  initializedName->set_global_qualification_required_for_type(outputGlobalQualification);
12776  initializedName->set_name_qualification_length_for_type(outputNameQualificationLength);
12777  initializedName->set_type_elaboration_required_for_type(outputTypeEvaluation);
12778 
12779  // There should be no type evaluation required for a variable reference, as I recall.
12780  ROSE_ASSERT(outputTypeEvaluation == false);
12781 
12782 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12783  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualificationOnType(): initializedName->get_name_qualification_length_for_type() = %d \n",initializedName->get_name_qualification_length_for_type());
12784  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualificationOnType(): initializedName->get_type_elaboration_required_for_type() = %s \n",initializedName->get_type_elaboration_required_for_type() ? "true" : "false");
12785  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualificationOnType(): initializedName->get_global_qualification_required_for_type() = %s \n",initializedName->get_global_qualification_required_for_type() ? "true" : "false");
12786 #endif
12787 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12788  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualificationOnType(SgInitializedName*): qualifier = %s \n",qualifier.c_str());
12789 #endif
12790 
12791  if (qualifiedNameMapForTypes.find(initializedName) == qualifiedNameMapForTypes.end())
12792  {
12793 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12794  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Inserting qualifier for type = %s into list at SgInitializedName IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),initializedName,initializedName->get_name().str());
12795 #endif
12796 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION
12797  printf("TEST T3: Inserting qualifier for type = %s into list at SgInitializedName IR node = %p = %s \n",qualifier.c_str(),initializedName,initializedName->get_name().str());
12798 #endif
12799  qualifiedNameMapForTypes.insert(std::pair<SgNode*,std::string>(initializedName,qualifier));
12800  }
12801  else
12802  {
12803  // If it already existes then overwrite the existing information.
12804  std::map<SgNode*,std::string>::iterator i = qualifiedNameMapForTypes.find(initializedName);
12805  ROSE_ASSERT (i != qualifiedNameMapForTypes.end());
12806 
12807 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
12808  string previousQualifier = i->second.c_str();
12809  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: test 12: replacing previousQualifier = %s with new qualifier = %s \n",previousQualifier.c_str(),qualifier.c_str());
12810 #endif
12811  if (i->second != qualifier)
12812  {
12813  i->second = qualifier;
12814 
12815 #ifdef ROSE_DEBUG_NEW_EDG_ROSE_CONNECTION
12816  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("WARNING: name in qualifiedNameMapForTypes already exists and is different... \n");
12817 #endif
12818  }
12819  }
12820  }

13107 NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(SgTemplateArgument* templateArgument, SgDeclarationStatement* declaration, int amountOfNameQualificationRequired)
13108  {
13109  // This function will generate the qualified name prefix (without the name of the declaration) and add it to
13110  // the map of name qualification strings referenced via the IR node that references the SgTemplateArgument.
13111 
13112  // DQ (6/1/2011): Note that the name qualification could be more complex than this function presently supports.
13113  // The use of derivation can permit there to be multiple legal qualified names for a single construct. There
13114  // could also be some qualified names using using type names that are private or protected and thus can only
13115  // be used in restricted contexts. This sumbject of multiple qualified names or selecting amongst them for
13116  // where each may be used is not handled presently.
13117 
13118  // DQ (9/23/2012): Note that the template arguments of the defining declaration don't appear to be set (only for
13119  // the nondefining declaration). This was a problem for test2012_220.C. The fix was to make sure that the
13120  // unparsing of the SgClassType consistantly uses the nondefining declaration, and it's template arguments.
13121 
13122  // Setup call to refactored code.
13123  int outputNameQualificationLength = 0;
13124  bool outputGlobalQualification = false;
13125  bool outputTypeEvaluation = false;
13126 
13127 #define DEBUG_TEMPLATE_ARGUMENT_NAME_QUALIFICATION 0
13128 
13129 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TEMPLATE_ARGUMENT_NAME_QUALIFICATION
13130  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualification(SgTemplateArgument*) \n");
13131 #endif
13132 
13133  SgScopeStatement * scope = traverseNonrealDeclForCorrectScope(declaration);
13134  string qualifier = setNameQualificationSupport(scope,amountOfNameQualificationRequired, outputNameQualificationLength, outputGlobalQualification, outputTypeEvaluation);
13135 
13136 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3) || DEBUG_TEMPLATE_ARGUMENT_NAME_QUALIFICATION
13137  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" - qualifier = %s\n", qualifier.c_str());
13138 #endif
13139 
13140 #if DEBUG_NONTERMINATION || 0
13141  printf ("In setNameQualification(SgTemplateArgument*): qualifier.length() = %zu \n",qualifier.length());
13142 #endif
13143 
13144 #if 1
13145  // DQ (5/23/2024): When the names start getting too long, use this as a way to short-circuit the runaway process.
13146  const size_t qualifier_length_limit = 6000;

13148  {
13149  static bool messageOutput = false;
13150  if (messageOutput == false)
13151  {
13152  // mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In setNameQualification(SgTemplateArgument*): qualifier.length() length exceeded (qualifier_length_limit = %zu) Setting disableNameQualification == true \n",qualifier_length_limit);
13153  printf ("In setNameQualification(SgTemplateArgument*): qualifier.length() length exceeded (qualifier_length_limit = %zu) Setting disableNameQualification == true \n",qualifier_length_limit);
13154  messageOutput = true;
13155 
13156  disableNameQualification = true;

13158 
13159  // Zero out the qualifier.
13160  qualifier = "";

13162 #endif

13164  // These may not be important under the newest version of name qualification that uses the qualified
13165  // name string map to IR nodes that reference the construct using the name qualification.
13166  templateArgument->set_global_qualification_required(outputGlobalQualification);
13167  templateArgument->set_name_qualification_length(outputNameQualificationLength);
13168  templateArgument->set_type_elaboration_required(outputTypeEvaluation);
13169

13177  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("In NameQualificationTraversal::setNameQualification(): templateArgument->get_global_qualification_required() = %s \n",templateArgument->get_global_qualification_required() ? "true" : "false");
13178 #endif

13181  // on both the template arguments of the defining and nondefining declarations.

13183  // DQ (9/22/2012): This is the bug to fix tomorrow morning...

13185  // or we should be sharing the SgTemplateArgument across both the non-defining and defining declarations.

14322 NameQualificationTraversal::setTemplateHeaderNameQualificationSupport(SgScopeStatement* scope, const int inputNameQualificationLength )
14323  {
14324  // DQ (9/7/2014): This function generates a string that is used with name qualification of template declarations.
14325  // For example:
14326  // template < typename T >
14327  // template < typename S >
14328  // void X<T>::A<S>::foobar (int x) { int a_value; }
14329  // Requires the template header string: "template < typename T > template < typename S >"
14330  // in addition to the usual name qualification (which here is in terms of template parameters
14331  // instead of template arguments (as in a template instantiation), namely "X<T>::A<S>::").
14332  // This new support for template headers also requires a new map of names to template declarations.
14333 
14334  // This is lower level support for the different overloaded setNameQualification() functions.
14335  // This function builds up the qualified name as a string and then returns it to be used in
14336  // either the map to names or the map to types (two different hash maps).
14337  string accumulated_template_header_name;
14338 
14339 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)

14341 #endif
14342 
14343  for (int i = 0; i < inputNameQualificationLength; i++)
14344  {
14345 #if (DEBUG_NAME_QUALIFICATION_LEVEL > 3)
14346  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- In loop: i = %d scope = %p = %s = %s \n",i,scope,scope->class_name().c_str(),SageInterface::get_name(scope).c_str());
14347 #endif
14348  string template_header_name;

14351  // it was not a problem that we didn't compute them quite right). These were being computed
14352  // as "class-name::class-name", but we need then to be computed to be:
14353  // "class-name<template-parameter>::class-name<template-parameter>" instead.
14354  // Other logic will have to add the template header where these are used (not clear how to
14355  // do that if we don't do it here).

14376 #endif
14377  // templateClassDeclaration->get_file_info()->display("SgTemplateInstantiationDecl trying to generate the qualified name: debug");
14378 
14379  SgTemplateParameterPtrList & templateParameterList = templateClassDeclaration->get_templateParameters();
14380  if (templateParameterList.empty() == false)

14646 // DQ (2/17/2019): Moved this to the name qualification file so we can work on it more easily.
14647 bool
14648 SgScopeStatement::hasAmbiguity(SgName & name, SgSymbol* symbol)
14649  {
14650  // DQ (2/16/2019): Added to support detection of ambiguity that drives the generation of name qualification.
14651 
14652  // NOTE: in the case where the declaration associated with the symbol is declared in the current scope, we can't have any ambiguity.
14653 
14654 #define DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY 0
14655 
14656 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14657  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("\nIn SgScopeStatement::hasAmbiguity(): name = %s symbol = %p = %s \n",name.str(),symbol,symbol->class_name().c_str());
14658 #endif
14659 
14660 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14661  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Print the symbol table for the current scope = %p = %s \n",this,this->class_name().c_str());
14662  this->get_symbol_table()->print();
14663 #endif
14664 
14665  // DQ (2/23/2019): This might be a possible alternative way (maybe a better way) to detect possible ambiguity.
14666  size_t numberOfSymbols = this->count_symbol (name);
14667 
14668 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14669  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("numberOfSymbols = %zu \n",numberOfSymbols);
14670 #endif
14671 
14672  size_t numberOfAliasSymbols = this->count_alias_symbol(name);
14673 
14674 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14675  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("numberOfAliasSymbols = %zu \n",numberOfAliasSymbols);
14676 #endif
14677 
14678  bool ambiguityDetected = false;
14679  if (numberOfAliasSymbols > 1)
14680  {
14681  // Detected ambiguity that will require some name qualification.
14682 
14683  // If there are multiple SgAliasSymbols then we need to know if they are associated with the same
14684  // base class or different base classes. If all from the same base class then there is no ambiguity.
14685  // else if they are from multiple base classes then it is the derivation that is providing the
14686  // possible ambiguity, which should be resolved via additional name qualification.
14687 
14688  std::vector<SgNode*> causalNodeList;
14689 
14690  rose_hash_multimap * internal_table = this->get_symbol_table()->get_table();
14691  ASSERT_not_null(internal_table);
14692 
14693 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14694  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Before loop over symbols \n");
14695 #endif
14696  std::pair<rose_hash_multimap::iterator, rose_hash_multimap::iterator> range = internal_table->equal_range (name);
14697  for (rose_hash_multimap::iterator i = range.first; i != range.second; ++i)
14698  {
14699  SgSymbol * orig_current_symbol = i->second;
14700  ASSERT_not_null(orig_current_symbol);
14701 
14702 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14703  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Top of loop over symbols \n");
14704  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("@@@@@@ orig_current_symbol = %p = %s \n",orig_current_symbol,orig_current_symbol->class_name().c_str());
14705 #endif
14706  SgAliasSymbol* aliasSymbol = isSgAliasSymbol(orig_current_symbol);
14707  if (aliasSymbol != NULL)
14708  {
14709  size_t causalNodeCount = aliasSymbol->get_causal_nodes().size();
14710 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14711  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- causalNodeCount = %zu \n",causalNodeCount);
14712 #endif
14713  if (causalNodeCount == 1)
14714  {
14715  // We need to know if each of the alias symbols has a different causal node.
14716  SgNode* causalNode = aliasSymbol->get_causal_nodes()[0];
14717 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14718  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- causalNode = %p \n",causalNode);
14719  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- find(causalNodeList.begin(),causalNodeList.end(),causalNode) == causalNodeList.end() = %s \n",
14720  find(causalNodeList.begin(),causalNodeList.end(),causalNode) == causalNodeList.end() ? "true" : "false");
14721 #endif
14722  if (find(causalNodeList.begin(),causalNodeList.end(),causalNode) == causalNodeList.end())
14723  {
14724  causalNodeList.push_back(causalNode);
14725  }
14726  }
14727  else
14728  {
14729  // We have identified an ambiguity.
14730 
14731  ROSE_ASSERT (causalNodeCount > 1);
14732 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14733  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) (" --- We have identified an ambiguity (causalNodeCount > 1): causalNodeCount = %zu \n",causalNodeCount);
14734 #endif
14735  ambiguityDetected = true;
14736  }
14737  }
14738  else
14739  {
14740  // DQ (2/17/2019): This case should be addressed.
14741  // I think this means that there is no ambiguity, since it would be through a single class
14742  // (else the base class is mixing alias symbols with the non-alias symbols and it is less
14743  // clear if there is an ambiguity (but there still could be and we would not detect it).
14744  // I need a test code to demonstrate this before it can be properly addressed.
14745 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14746  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Note: In SgScopeStatement::hasAmbiguity(): Found a non SgAliasSymbol: orig_current_symbol = %p = %s \n",
14747  orig_current_symbol,orig_current_symbol->class_name().c_str());
14748 #endif
14749  }
14750 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14751  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Bottom of loop over symbols: causalNodeList.size() = %zu \n",causalNodeList.size());
14752 #endif
14753  }
14754 
14755 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14756  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("After loop over symbols: causalNodeList.size() = %zu \n",causalNodeList.size());
14757 #endif
14758 
14759  if (causalNodeList.size() > 1)
14760  {
14761  ambiguityDetected = true;
14762  }
14763 
14764 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14765  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Using count_alias_symbol(): Detected ambiguity that will require some name qualification \n");
14766 #endif
14767  // ambiguityDetected = true;
14768  }
14769  else
14770  {
14771  // No ambiguity that will require any name qualification.
14772 
14773 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14774  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Using count_alias_symbol(): No ambiguity that will require any name qualification \n");
14775 #endif
14776  // Lookup the SgAliasSymbol in the class scope.
14777  SgAliasSymbol* aliasSymbol = this->lookup_alias_symbol(name,symbol);
14778  // ASSERT_not_null(aliasSymbol);
14779  if (aliasSymbol != NULL)
14780  {
14781  ROSE_ASSERT(aliasSymbol->get_causal_nodes().empty() == false);
14782  if (aliasSymbol->get_causal_nodes().size() > 1)
14783  {
14784  // Detected ambiguity that will require some name qualification.
14785 
14786 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14787  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Detected ambiguity that will require some name qualification \n");
14788 #endif
14789  ambiguityDetected = true;
14790  }
14791  else
14792  {
14793  if (numberOfSymbols > 1)
14794  {
14795 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14796  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Detected multible SgSymbol are available: consider this an ambiguity: numberOfSymbols = %zu \n",numberOfSymbols);
14797 #endif
14798  ambiguityDetected = true;
14799  }
14800  else
14801  {
14802  // No ambiguity that will require any name qualification.
14803 
14804 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14805  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("No ambiguity that will require any name qualification \n");
14806 #endif
14807  }
14808  }
14809  }
14810  else
14811  {
14812 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14813  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("No SgAliasSymbol is available \n");
14814 #endif
14815  if (numberOfSymbols > 1)
14816  {
14817 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14818  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("Detected multible SgSymbol are available: consider this an ambiguity: numberOfSymbols = %zu \n",numberOfSymbols);
14819 #endif
14820  ambiguityDetected = true;
14821  }
14822  else
14823  {
14824 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14825  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("No SgSymbol or only one SgSymbol is available \n");
14826 #endif
14827  }
14828  }
14829  }
14830 
14831 #if DEBUG_HAS_AMBIGUITY
14832  mfprintf(mlog [ WARN ] ) ("ambiguityDetected = %s \n",ambiguityDetected ? "true" : "false");
14833 #endif
14834 
14835  return ambiguityDetected;
14836  }
